input:
If you decide to eat here, just be aware it is going to take about 2 hours from beginning to end. We have tried it multiple times, because I want to like it! I have been to it's other locations in NJ and never had a bad experience. 

The food is good, but it takes a very long time to come out. The waitstaff is very young, but usually pleasant. We have just had too many experiences where we spent way too long waiting. We usually opt for another diner or restaurant on the weekends, in order to be done quicker.
Help me polish this: If you choose to dine at this establishment, please be prepared for a lengthy experience lasting approximately 2 hours from start to finish. Despite our repeated visits in an effort to develop a liking for it, we have often encountered extended waiting periods. It is worth mentioning that we have had positive experiences at its other locations in NJ. Although the food is enjoyable, its preparation time is significantly longer. The waitstaff, while youthful, is typically cordial. However, the excessive waiting has led us to opt for alternative diners or restaurants on weekends to ensure a more expeditious dining experience.

input:
I've taken a lot of spin classes over the years, and nothing compares to the classes at Body Cycle. From the nice, clean space and amazing bikes, to the welcoming and motivating instructors, every class is a top notch work out.

For anyone who struggles to fit workouts in, the online scheduling system makes it easy to plan ahead (and there's no need to line up way in advanced like many gyms make you do).

There is no way I can write this review without giving Russell, the owner of Body Cycle, a shout out. Russell's passion for fitness and cycling is so evident, as is his desire for all of his clients to succeed. He is always dropping in to classes to check in/provide encouragement, and is open to ideas and recommendations from anyone. Russell always wears a smile on his face, even when he's kicking your butt in class!
Help me polish this:
I highly recommend Body Cycle for spin classes. Having taken numerous spin classes throughout the years, I can confidently say that nothing compares to the experience at Body Cycle. The facility is impeccably clean and well-maintained, and the top-of-the-line bikes ensure a smooth and comfortable ride.

What truly sets Body Cycle apart, however, is the exceptional quality of the instructors. They create a welcoming and motivating atmosphere that pushes you to your limits while still making the workout enjoyable. Their expertise and passion for cycling are evident in every class, guaranteeing a top-notch workout each time.

One aspect of Body Cycle that is especially convenient is their online scheduling system. Unlike many other gyms, there's no need to line up in advance. The user-friendly online platform allows you to easily plan ahead, making it easier to fit workouts into your busy schedule.

Lastly, I must give a special shoutout to Russell, the owner of Body Cycle. His unwavering dedication to fitness and cycling is inspiring. Russell goes above and beyond to ensure the success of all his clients, regularly checking in and providing encouragement during classes. He is also receptive to ideas and recommendations from anyone, truly valuing the input of his clients. Even when he's pushing you to your limits in class, his infectious smile never fades.

In conclusion, if you're looking for an exceptional spin class experience, look no further than Body Cycle. From the state-of-the-art facility to the exceptional instructors and the supportive owner, every aspect of Body Cycle is truly top-notch.

input: Family diner. Had the buffet. Eclectic assortment: a large chicken leg, fried jalapeño, tamale, two rolled grape leaves, fresh melon. All good. Lots of Mexican choices there. Also has a menu with breakfast served all day long. Friendly, attentive staff. Good place for a casual relaxed meal with no expectations. Next to the Clarion Hotel.
Help me polish this:
Family Diner: A Delicious Buffet Experience

Indulging in the delectable offerings of the family diner was truly a remarkable experience. The buffet provided a delightful and eclectic assortment of flavors that left my taste buds begging for more. From the tantalizingly large chicken leg to the crispy fried jalapeño, the tamale bursting with flavors, the two impeccably rolled grape leaves, and the refreshing taste of fresh melon - every dish surpassed my expectations.

What truly impressed me about this diner was the wide array of Mexican choices available. Each dish effortlessly showcased the vibrant and authentic flavors of Mexico, making it a must-visit spot for Mexican cuisine enthusiasts.

Not just limited to the buffet, this diner also boasts a diverse menu with the option to enjoy breakfast all day long. The dedication to providing this versatile dining experience ensures that everyone's cravings are catered to, regardless of the time of day.

The staff at the family diner were nothing short of extraordinary. Their attentive and friendly demeanor added an extra layer of warmth to the dining experience. From the moment I walked in to the moment I left, I felt genuinely welcomed and valued as a diner. Their exceptional service truly elevated the overall ambiance of the diner and made it an even more pleasant place to enjoy a casual and relaxed meal.

Conveniently located next to the Clarion Hotel, this family diner presents the perfect spot to satisfy your cravings. It offers a comfortable and casual environment where you can enjoy a meal with no expectations, simply indulging in the delightful flavors it has to offer.

In conclusion, the family diner's buffet provides an unparalleled selection of dishes, with an emphasis on Mexican cuisine, ensuring that there's something for every palate. Combined with the friendly and attentive staff and the overall relaxed atmosphere, this diner guarantees a memorable dining experience that will leave you craving a return visit.

input: Wow!  Yummy, different,  delicious.   Our favorite is the lamb curry and korma.  With 10 different kinds of naan!!!  Don't let the outside deter you (because we almost changed our minds)...go in and try something new!   You'll be glad you did!
Help me polish this:
Wow! This place is absolutely amazing. The food here is a delightful combination of unique flavors that are simply delicious. Our all-time favorites are the lamb curry and korma dishes. But what sets this place apart is their extensive selection of naan; they offer a mind-blowing variety of ten different types! 

At first glance, the exterior might not seem inviting, and we almost let it change our minds. However, don't let that deter you. Take a leap of faith and step inside to try something new. Trust us, you won't regret it. The culinary experience here will surpass your expectations, and you'll be left with a gratifying feeling of satisfaction.

input: Cute interior and owner (?) gave us tour of upcoming patio/rooftop area which will be great on beautiful days like today. Cheese curds were very good and very filling. Really like that sandwiches come w salad, esp after eating too many curds! Had the onion, gruyere, tomato sandwich. Wasn't too much cheese which I liked. Needed something else...pepper jelly maybe. Would like to see more menu options added such as salads w fun cheeses. Lots of beer and wine as well as limited cocktails. Next time I will try one of the draft wines.
Help me polish this: The interior of the place was charming, and the owner kindly gave us a tour of the upcoming patio/rooftop area, which will no doubt be perfect for enjoying beautiful days like today. We couldn't resist trying the cheese curds, and they were absolutely delightful - not only were they delicious, but they were also quite filling. It was a pleasant surprise that the sandwiches were served with salad, especially after indulging in too many curds! I opted for the onion, gruyere, and tomato sandwich, and I must say, the proportion of cheese was just right for my taste. However, I felt like it needed a little something extra - perhaps some pepper jelly would have given it that extra kick. It would be wonderful if they could add more menu options, particularly salads featuring unique cheeses. They had an extensive selection of beer and wine, along with a limited offering of cocktails. I'm definitely intrigued to try one of their draft wines on my next visit.

input: I am a long term frequent customer of this establishment. I just went in to order take out (3 apps) and was told they're too busy to do it. Really? The place is maybe half full at best. Does your dick reach your ass? Yes? Go fuck yourself! I'm a frequent customer AND great tipper. Glad that Kanella just opened. NEVER going back to dmitris!
Help me polish this:
I am a valued and loyal customer of this establishment, having frequented it for an extended period of time. Today, I went in to place a take-out order consisting of three appetizers but was informed that they were unable to accommodate my request due to being busy. However, I couldn't help but notice that the restaurant was only half full at best. I was quite taken aback by this response.

I must express my disappointment and frustration with this situation. As someone who has shown consistent support to your establishment and always provided generous tips, I expected a higher level of service. Luckily, I recently discovered that Kanella has opened nearby, and I will now be redirecting my patronage there.

I want to make it clear that I will not be returning to Dimitri's due to this experience. The lack of consideration and professionalism displayed by the staff is unacceptable.

input: Loved this tour! I grabbed a groupon and the price was great. It was the perfect way to explore New Orleans for someone who'd never been there before and didn't know a lot about the history of the city. Our tour guide had tons of interesting tidbits about the city, and I really enjoyed the experience. Highly recommended tour. I actually thought we were just going to tour through the cemetery, but she took us around the French Quarter for the first hour, and the cemetery for the second half of the tour. You'll meet up in front of a grocery store (seems strange at first, but it's not terribly hard to find, and it'll give you a chance to get some water), and you'll stop at a visitor center part way through the tour for a bathroom break if needed. This tour was one of my favorite parts of my trip!
Help me polish this:
I absolutely loved this tour! I found a fantastic deal on Groupon, making it a great value for the price. As someone who had never been to New Orleans before and had limited knowledge about the city's history, this tour was the perfect way for me to explore. Our tour guide was incredibly knowledgeable and shared fascinating tidbits about the city throughout the entire experience. I highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting New Orleans.

To my surprise, the tour exceeded my expectations. I originally thought it would solely be a tour of the cemetery, but we actually started off by exploring the French Quarter for the first hour. It was a delightful way to begin the experience. Meeting up in front of a grocery store may seem odd at first, but it's actually not difficult to find and offers a chance to grab some water beforehand. Additionally, there was a convenient bathroom break at a visitor center midway through the tour, which was much appreciated.

Overall, this tour was one of the highlights of my trip. I thoroughly enjoyed it and it left me with a deeper appreciation for the history and culture of New Orleans.

input: Amazingly amazing wings and homemade bleu cheese. Had the ribeye: tender, perfectly prepared, delicious. Nice selection of craft beers. Would DEFINITELY recommend checking out this hidden gem.
Help me polish this: Absolutely outstanding wings accompanied by a delectable homemade bleu cheese dip. The ribeye was a true masterpiece - tender, expertly cooked, and bursting with incredible flavors. Moreover, their impressive assortment of craft beers enhanced the overall dining experience. I wholeheartedly recommend visiting this hidden gem; you won't be disappointed!

input: This easter instead of going to Lopez Lake we went to Los Padres National Forest which is really pretty but if you go to white rock the staff needs to cut down all the dead grass that invades the rock and the water. I would wish the staff would also clean or get rid of the dead grass that's also living by the water. The water is really green and dirty. Los padres national forest staff need to work hard to maintain this forest looking pretty and not like a dumpster. Even Cachuma lake looks like they put a bit more effort.
Help me polish this: This Easter, instead of visiting Lopez Lake, we decided to explore the breathtaking Los Padres National Forest. While the forest is undeniably beautiful, one area called White Rock would benefit greatly from the staff's attention in maintaining its natural charm. Currently, the dead grass overgrows and intrudes upon the rock and water, obstructing the picturesque view. It would be greatly appreciated if the staff could also address the presence of dead grass near the water, as it detracts from the overall appeal. Additionally, the water appears murky and green, suggesting that more thorough cleaning efforts are necessary. The staff responsible for maintaining the Los Padres National Forest should prioritize their efforts to ensure it remains pristine, rather than resembling a neglected area. Comparatively, even Cachuma Lake seems to receive more thoughtful attention and care in its upkeep.

input: Had a party of 6 here for hibachi. Our waitress brought our separate sushi orders on one plate so we couldn't really tell who's was who's and forgot several items on an order. I understand making mistakes but the restaraunt was really quiet so we were kind of surprised. Usually hibachi is a fun lively experience and our  cook  said maybe three words, but he cooked very well his name was Francisco. Service was fishy, food was pretty good, and im hoping it was just an off night here. But for the money I wouldn't go back.
Help me polish this: We recently had a party of 6 at this hibachi restaurant. Unfortunately, our experience was not as enjoyable as we had hoped. Our waitress made a mistake by bringing our separate sushi orders on one plate, causing confusion as we couldn't distinguish whose sushi belonged to whom. Additionally, she forgot several items from one of our orders. We understand that mistakes happen, but considering the restaurant was fairly quiet, we were taken aback. Usually, hibachi dining offers a fun and lively experience; however, our cook seemed disengaged and only spoke a few words throughout the meal. On the positive side, he cooked the food very well, and his name was Francisco. The overall service left something to be desired, but the quality of the food was decent. We are hoping that this was just an off night for the restaurant. Considering the price we paid, though, we probably wouldn't choose to dine here again.

input:
My experience with Shalimar was nothing but wonderful. 
I wanted to get my engagement ring sized and was told over the phone that it could probably be done within the day. 
When I brought it by, the team confirmed that the jeweler would be able to accommodate my same-day request and that it would be around $40 (simple band, decrease by three full sizes).
I checked my size one more time, confirmed, and left to let them do their thing.
When I came to pick up later that afternoon, the ring was too small. It's very important to note that Shalimar sized the ring perfectly, but that I made a mistake and should've gone up a half-size.
The Shalimar group were completely understanding and accommodating, even resizing my ring back up and getting it back to me within an hour at no charge! Even though it was my mistake!
The associates' attitudes in dealing with what was a pretty embarrassing situation instantly earned my satisfaction and loyalty as a customer. Very grateful for such a wonderful experience.
Help me polish this:
I had a fantastic experience with Shalimar. I needed to have my engagement ring resized and they assured me over the phone that it could be done on the same day. When I arrived at the store, the team confirmed that the jeweler could accommodate my request and estimated a cost of around $40 for a simple band to be decreased by three full sizes. Before leaving, I double-checked my ring size and confirmed it with them.

Later that afternoon when I returned to pick up the ring, I discovered that it was too small. It's important to emphasize that Shalimar had sized the ring correctly, but the mistake was entirely mine as I should have ordered a half size larger. However, the Shalimar staff were incredibly understanding and accommodating. They immediately resized the ring back up and had it ready for me in just one hour, and they did all of this at no charge, even though it was my mistake!

The way the associates handled this somewhat embarrassing situation instantly won my satisfaction and loyalty as a customer. I am sincerely grateful for such a wonderful experience with Shalimar.

input: Locals recommended Milktooth, and it's an amazing jewel of Indianapolis. I'm glade I had the chance to experience this.
Help me polish this: The locals highly recommended Milktooth, and after experiencing it myself, I can confidently say it is an extraordinary gem in Indianapolis. I feel grateful to have had the opportunity to indulge in this incredible culinary experience.

input: Love going here for happy hour or dinner!  Great patio with fans to beat the StL heat!   Also...very accomodating at this location.  I like the Veal Milanese but with mixed greens instead of pasta!  they'll modify the menu to suit your taste!
Help me polish this: I absolutely love this place for happy hour or dinner! The patio is fantastic, equipped with fans to help you stay cool in the StL heat. Moreover, the staff is incredibly accommodating. My personal favorite is the Veal Milanese, but I request it with mixed greens instead of pasta. The best part is that they are more than happy to customize the menu to suit your individual taste preferences.

input:
Good food--loved the gnocchi with marinara
the baked eggplant appetizer was very good too

The service was very slow, but despite this, I'd go back, the food is just that good
Help me polish this: I thoroughly enjoyed the gnocchi with marinara sauce, as well as the delicious baked eggplant appetizer. Although the service was notably slow, the exceptional quality of the food makes me willing to return again.

input:
The bun makes the Sonoran Dog. It's like a snuggie for the pup. A first, it seems ridiculous and almost like it's going to be too much, exactly like everyone's favorite blanket with sleeves. Too much softness, too much smush, too indulgent.  Wrong. It's warm, soft, chewy, fragrant, and it succeeds where other famed Sonoran Dogs fail. 

The hot dog itself is flavorful, but I would prefer that it or the bacon have a little more bite or snap to better hold their own against the dominant mustard and onions. 

I'm with the masses on the carne asada caramelo. Excellent tortilla, salty, melty cheese, and great carne. 

Super cheap and you can drive through.
Help me polish this:
The bun used to create the Sonoran Dog is like a cozy snuggie for the pup. At first glance, it may appear excessive and remind you of everyone's beloved blanket with sleeves - too soft, too fluffy, almost indulgent. But, don't be mistaken. This bun is the perfect balance of warm, soft, chewy, and fragrant, and it surpasses other well-known Sonoran Dogs in taste.

The hot dog itself is undeniably flavorful, although I personally feel that either the hot dog or the bacon could benefit from a bit more of a bite or snap, to better hold their ground against the dominant mustard and onions.

I wholeheartedly agree with the general consensus on the carne asada caramelo. The tortilla is excellent, the cheese is salty and melty, and the carne asada itself is fantastic.

Furthermore, the affordability of this delightful treat, coupled with the convenience of being able to drive through, make it an even more appealing choice.

input: Great place for breakfast! I had the waffle, which was fluffy and perfect, and home fries which were nice and smashed and crunchy. Friendly waitstaff. Will definitely be back!
Help me polish this: I highly recommend this place for breakfast! The waffle I had was absolutely fluffy and cooked to perfection, while the home fries were wonderfully smashed and had a satisfying crunch. The waitstaff was extremely friendly and welcoming. I will definitely be returning in the future!

input: Tremendous service (Big shout out to Douglas) that complemented the delicious food. Pretty expensive establishment (40-50$ avg for your main course), but its definitely backs that up with an atmosphere that's comparable with any of the top tier restaurants across the country.
Help me polish this: I am blown away by the tremendous service, and I would like to give a big shout out to Douglas who made our experience unforgettable. Although this establishment may come with a pretty expensive price tag, ranging from $40 to $50, the delicious food and exceptional service definitely justifies it. The atmosphere is on par with any of the top-tier restaurants found across the country.

input: The hubby and I have been here on multiple occasions and we have loved every part of the meal, every single time. Everyone from the servers to the bartender is very knowledgable about the menu and was able to immediately recommend items I could eat as-is, substitute or delete to make something safe for this Celiac girl to eat. The wine and cocktail menus are spot on. The food divine.  My only wish is that they would have a gluten-free dessert, we've always had to go elsewhere for something sweet. But that is not a big deal and I still want to go here time and time again.
Help me polish this: My husband and I have frequented this place on numerous occasions, and each time we have been delighted with every aspect of our meal. From the knowledgeable servers to the skilled bartender, the entire staff is well-versed in the menu and always able to suggest options suitable for someone with Celiac disease like me—whether it be a dish I can enjoy as-is, a substitution, or a modification. The wine and cocktail menus are impeccable, and the food itself is simply divine. The only small disappointment is the absence of a gluten-free dessert; we've always had to venture elsewhere for something sweet. However, this minor inconvenience does not deter me from wanting to return to this establishment time and time again.

input: I go to blow bar to get my brows done by natalie (brow specialist) which i highly recommend she is great does a great job on my eyebrows! But then i got a blow by victoria!! Wow i was impress i have thin, straight, dead hair and she left me with the biggest volume ive ever had!!! Tried another girl but didnt like it as much so victoria will be my girl for ever; very beautiful clean place!!!
Help me polish this: I highly recommend visiting the blow bar for excellent brow services provided by Natalie, their expert brow specialist. Natalie does an incredible job shaping my eyebrows, and I am always happy with the results. Additionally, I recently had a blowout by Victoria, and I was absolutely impressed. Despite having thin and lifeless hair, Victoria gave me the most voluminous hair I have ever had! Although I tried services from another stylist, Victoria's expertise stands out, and I have decided to stick with her every time. Moreover, the blow bar itself is a beautiful and clean establishment.

input: My absolute favorite cafe in the city. Their black and white latte is probably the best I've ever had (not too sweet and just the right amount of foam), soups are always really good (even for non-soup people) and there's just a lot of space to do work. The noise level is perfect, the music is at a perfect level, and I always enjoy when patrons bring their dogs. I'll keep giving them my business for as long as I can.
Help me polish this: My personal go-to cafe in the city is undoubtedly my absolute favorite. Without a doubt, their black and white latte stands out as the pinnacle of perfection, striking a delicate balance between sweetness and foam. It's simply unparalleled. Even if you're not particularly fond of soup, their offerings will pleasantly surprise you every time. And what's more, the ambiance is second to none, with ample space to set up and focus on work. The noise level maintains an ideal equilibrium, allowing for focused productivity, while the carefully curated music sets a delightful backdrop. And I must say, there's something truly heartwarming about the delightful presence of patrons' canine companions. As long as I am able, I will continue to be a loyal customer, unwavering in my support for this exceptional establishment.

input:
HOLY SMOKES!

actual pumpkin pie mixed in with the frozen custard......are you kidding me? Why hasn't this become a huge sweep the nation treat. 

The best part was the chunks of pie crust. Like finding a diamond inside another diamond. Super yummy.
Help me polish this:
Wow, what an incredible combination! I can't believe there's real pumpkin pie mixed in with the frozen custard. Why hasn't this delightful treat taken the nation by storm already?

The most delightful surprise was definitely the chunks of pie crust. It felt like discovering a diamond within another diamond. The taste was absolutely heavenly.

input: Upland is a brewery based out of Bloomington, Indiana that has become popular enough to open up a couple additional locations in central Indiana.  All of their beers are very good, and I am also a fan of their burgers and tenderloins.  Therefore, I was excited to try their pizza, but I don't think it ended up being on par with these other items.  My margherita pizza had a cracker-like crust and was pretty light overall.  The cheese was good, but none of the other toppings added much flavor.  There was no red sauce as is typical for a true margherita pizza.  My opinion is that Upland's pizza might serve as a nice appetizer for a group, but I'll be sticking with their burgers or tenderloins as my meal of choice on future visits.
Help me polish this: Upland Brewing Company, a renowned brewery originating from Bloomington, Indiana, has rapidly gained popularity and successfully expanded to multiple locations in central Indiana. Renowned for their exceptional beer selection, the dining experience at Upland is further enhanced by their delicious burgers and tenderloins. Despite my enthusiasm to try their pizza, it unfortunately did not meet the high standards set by their other offerings. The margherita pizza boasted a thin, cracker-like crust and possessed a light overall taste. While the cheese was satisfactory, the other toppings failed to contribute any notable flavors, and the absence of the customary red sauce was disappointing. In my view, Upland's pizza could function as a pleasant appetizer for a group, but I will undoubtedly be opting for their scrumptious burgers or tenderloins as my preferred meal during future visits.

input: I thoroughly enjoyed the show.  Chill way to spend a Friday night.
Help me polish this: I had an amazing time at the show! It was such a relaxed and enjoyable way to spend a Friday night.

input: Yes, this is the only sushi place in town. However, it is great when you're craving sushi and don't have time to go somewhere else. The salmon is probably the best fish they have, so we always order salmon. We also love their spicy edamame, tempura, ocean salad, and cabbage salad. Service has always been friendly and quick!
Help me polish this: Yes, indeed! This happens to be the sole sushi establishment in our town. Nevertheless, it proves to be an excellent choice whenever one has a craving for sushi but lacks the luxury of time to venture elsewhere. Their salmon, without a doubt, takes the crown as the standout fish, hence why it is our go-to order. Moreover, their spicy edamame, tempura, ocean salad, and cabbage salad have become cherished favorites of ours. Consistently, the service has been nothing short of friendly and prompt!

input:
I was really between 3 and 4 stars for this one. I LOVE the 96th street Naked Tchopstix so I was very excited to see this one which is closer to my house.
The vibe is totally different as this is geared more to take out although they do have a decent size dining area. You order at the counter and they deliver it.
My daughter and I tried the sushi bowl. You pick up a piece of paper and  select from a choice of proteins, vegetables, rice and toppings. I like the fact that it is on paper and you don't have to guess what things are or have to shout over the counter to tell the server what you want. The sushi bowl was good but not wonderful. The choices particularly of the vegetables seemed a little too limiting and I felt I had more rice than other food items. The sauces were tasty. My husband ordered the Maui roll which is my favorite roll at the 96th street location and this just was not up that standard. It was good but the quality and consistently was not as good as at 96th street. I would go back though and I think a lot of people would be happy with the sushi bowls. I do want to make a comment about the low reviews that people have given the place because of service. People - it is a sushi place - it isn't McDonalds- so it will be a bit slower. You are not going to order and get out of there in five minutes even though it is called express. As a healthy alternative to fast food in the area, it is worth the wait. Oh and try the bubble tea. I had the strawberry and it was quite yummy. Next time I am going to try the vanilla chai.
Help me polish this:
I was torn between giving this place 3 or 4 stars. I absolutely adore the 96th street Naked Tchopstix, so I was thrilled to discover this new location closer to my home.

The atmosphere here is totally different, leaning more towards takeout, although they do offer a decent-sized dining area. You place your order at the counter and they bring it to you.

My daughter and I decided to try the sushi bowl. You grab a piece of paper and customize your bowl by choosing from a selection of proteins, vegetables, rice, and toppings. I really appreciate the fact that everything is written down on paper, so no guesswork or raising your voice to communicate your preferences. The sushi bowl was good, but not exceptional. The vegetable options, in particular, felt somewhat limited, and there seemed to be more rice than other ingredients. However, the sauces were delicious.

On the other hand, my husband ordered the Maui roll, my absolute favorite at the 96th street location, but unfortunately, it didn't meet the same standard. It was still good, but the quality and consistency were not on par with what we're used to at 96th street. Despite this, I still think many people would be satisfied with the sushi bowls, and I would give it another try.

I do want to address the negative reviews regarding the service. People need to understand that this is a sushi place, not McDonald's, so it's natural for things to take a bit longer. You won't get in and out in five minutes, even though they call it "express." As a healthy alternative to fast food in the area, it's worth the wait. Oh, and definitely give their bubble tea a shot. I had the strawberry flavor, and it was absolutely delicious. Next time, I plan on trying the vanilla chai.

input: Went for lunch. Beef brisket sandwich was awesome.   So juicy and tender.    Pulled pork was was just as good!
Help me polish this: I had a delicious lunch today. The beef brisket sandwich I ordered was absolutely amazing - so juicy and tender. It truly exceeded my expectations. Equally as impressive was the pulled pork sandwich, which was just as good. I thoroughly enjoyed every bite of both dishes.

input: Best thai food in the area.  Everything was authentic and delicious.  Will definitely be back again and again.
Help me polish this: Discover the finest Thai cuisine in the area! Indulge in an unforgettable dining experience where every dish is meticulously crafted to deliver an authentic and exquisite taste. From the robust flavors of traditional Thai spices to the harmony of fresh ingredients, our menu will tantalize your taste buds and leave you craving for more. Prepare to embark on a culinary journey that will exceed your expectations, as we strive to deliver an exceptional dining experience every time. Don't miss the opportunity to savor our delectable offerings - we guarantee you'll be coming back for more, time and time again.

input: Service was crappy, and food was mediocre.  I wish I would have picked some other place for my last dinner in town.
Help me polish this: The service provided was subpar, and the quality of the food was average at best. Regrettably, I wish I had chosen a different establishment for my final dinner in town.

input:
I recently had dinner here with my wife over the weekend and could not have been more pleased! 

Our meal was excellent! My wife and I were astounded by how quickly our food came out! Everything tasted fresh and homemade which we both appreciated. 

The only problem was trying to pick something from the menu as there were too many delicious sounding items to choose from. We will definitely be returning to try more items! Can't wait to see what the next chef specials will be!
Help me polish this:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at this establishment with my wife over the weekend, and I must say it was an exceptional experience! 

From the moment we sat down, we were impressed with the outstanding service and the amazing speed at which our food was brought out. It was truly delightful to be served promptly without compromising on the quality of the dishes. 

The taste of each dish was beyond compare - every bite was a testament to the fresh ingredients and a genuine homemade touch. We found it quite refreshing to have a restaurant that pays such attention to detail and takes pride in preparing their meals with care.

Although it was a bit of a challenge to narrow down our choices from the extensive menu, we viewed it as a testament to the remarkable variety and quality of the options available. We are already looking forward to our next visit, eager to explore more tantalizing offerings. The anticipation of discovering the chef's specials only adds to our excitement!

Overall, our dinner experience here exceeded our expectations. We highly recommend this establishment to anyone seeking a truly exceptional dining experience.

input: I at least have to give this restaurant two stars due to the decent food. But while on a dinner meeting and after spending $100 on entrées and appetizers, I had to flag down the assistant cook, (the guy in bright red baggy pants watching TV), to see if I could get more avocado for my tuna entrée.  He made it very apparent and direct that he could not help me with that situation and I would have to flag down my  waitress so she could bill me for the four dollar avocado.
Help me polish this: At the very least, I have to give this restaurant two stars considering the quality of their food. However, during a recent dinner meeting where we spent $100 on entrées and appetizers, I faced a peculiar situation. Our room was large and featured free WiFi (likewise always appreciated), a huge bathroom area with large shower (with two shower heads), TV, a large jetted bathtub and a phone next to the commode.  There were dual sinks and lots of counter space.  Plenty of towels were supplied.  The roomy main area had a king bed with night stands, closet, TV, mini fridge, dresser with two drawers, a safe, table for computer or writing, complimentary bottles of water, and three nicely upholstered chairs and table. input:
The only reason I didn't give this restaurant a 5 star rating, is because of one single pretentious waiter. As a 4 night guest at Hotel Palomar, the location of the restaurant is an obvious plus. The first night of my stay, I met a coworker in the restaurant for a cocktail. When we arrived, the host staff were busy and not available, so we just walked in. The restaurant was not too busy, so we just looked at a small table next to the bar and proceeded to take a seat. A waiter came by and I quickly asked if we could have a seat, before sitting down and told him we'd only be having cocktails. He stumbled on his reply, and in an irritated/in-convinced tone, told me "I guess it would be fine" and basically just kept walking mid sentence. My guest and I brushed it off, and started having a conversation while looking at the drink menu. To make a long story short, he was distant and we both got the "couldn't be bothered" vibe from him. When it came to the bill, we asked if it could be split due to company transaction policies, and you would have thought asked him for some inconceivable task. We basically spent the rest of our night and elevator ride to our room in shock of the rudeness we had just experienced. 

Although that situation left a bad taste in our mouth, and the night before we decided to avoid the restaurant, we decided to grab another cocktail and give this place one more try. After looking around and ensuring "last nights waiter" wasn't on shift, we walked over to the bar and started looking over the menu. Instantly, the bartender greeted us with pleasant small talk and made us feel 100% welcome. He asked about our day, recommended cocktails and was a completely genuine person. This guy (I think his name was Ben) is an absolute star! He gave us lessons on Whiskey, described how to make classic cocktails, and was 100% invested in our experience. This is exactly what a bartender at a 4/5 star establishment should be - actually he exceeds that. He was kind, funny, friendly and completely redeemed this restaurant/bar from our terrible experience the night before. 
I also ordered room service last night from this restaurant, and it was amazing. The bacon wrapped dates and chocolate cake are to die for! Great restaurant and amazing bartender(s). Too bad one bad egg could have spoiled this experience.

input:
If you want to pay for everything a la carte this is the place for you.

They brought a basket of chips and some tomato sauce which I asked politely for something spicier and some pico de gallo.  She brought them happily to me and the salsa was much better.  When asked what we would like to drink I asked for a coke and she brought out a bottle which I stated I wanted the fountain drink.  She said "oh that's only Pepsi".  Never mentioned that they only had bottle drinks for coke.  
We ordered our food which was reasonably priced, asked for sour cream and also to put cheese on the taco.  She let us know cheese was extra.  
It was $2.50 extra for another basket of chips.  
When I received the bill we paid more for the condiments then the actual food.  Side of sour cream 2.00, pico de gallo 2.50, salsa 2.00, chips 2.50, cheese 1.00 and the bottled coke that we didn't want 5.00.  
Just a suggestion...when you order anything make sure to ask if there is an extra charge.

input: It was my fiance's birthday and he decided he wanted a good, laid back Thai restaurant for dinner. Yelp steered us in the Jasmine Rice direction, and it was definitely a good decision. We wanted the summer rolls, which were on the menu, but apparently will not be available until summer, so we settled on the pan-fried dumplings. The flavor was good, but I don't think we'd order them again. We got the green curry fried rice with duck and chicken pad thai. Both of those dishes were great, but the duck stole the show. That was some the of tastiest duck I've ever had. The pad thai was a bit sweet for us, so I think we'd try a different noodle dish when we return. But it was still very good, especially with some chili sauce mixed in. Our service was good, but other people had issues. One table was rushing to get to a show at the Kimmel Center and waited quite a while for their meal (and were going to be late). Another person who got take-out was missing one of their items (but the owner realized it and called him and walked the dish to his house, which was very nice). Overall, good quality Thai! We would definitely go back.

All in all, Jasmine Rice delivered on quality Thai cuisine, and it's a place we would certainly consider revisiting.

And if you're a fan of seasonal brews, I highly recommend giving their Pumpkin Seasonal Beer a try - it stands toe-to-toe with some of the best pumpkin beers out there.

input: Farmhouse, rustic, chic.Helpful staff with great ideas to decorate your home. Prices reasonable. Store has items from Joanna Gaines ( Fixer Upper) and much more. Finally a good home store in SB with reasonable prices.

input:
My go to menu is coconut soup and pad thai with protein. I tried same menu here. 
Actually really like their coconut soup. They used enough amount of coconut milk that soup was really creamy and wasn't over powering with herb. I am so used to Americanized thai cuisine that I prefer less herb on my dish except cilantro.
Pat thai was great too. Liked the amount of peanut they used, noodle was chewy and perfect and not too sweet. They gave me generous amount of chicken and white meat wasn't dry so I was very happy with my meal.

Here is the polished version:

As someone accustomed to Americanized Thai cuisine, I tend to prefer dishes that aren't excessively herb-heavy, with the exception of cilantro.

The pad thai was equally delightful. The peanut flavor was just right, and the noodles had a perfect chewiness without being overly sweet. What made it even better was the generous portion of chicken they included. The white meat wasn't dry at all, leaving me extremely satisfied with my meal."

input: Excellent service! Great diner food and breakfast is served all day. Came here for lunch- they were busy but very friendly and hospitable. Easy to get to off the 295.

input:

input:
We were a bit weary about trying the Shellfish Company on the Wharf as more often than not, many places like these (see Cannery Row, Monterey) feast on a captive audience and provide sub-standard fare at high prices.

However, emboldened by the perennial good reviews on Yelp, we suppressed our initial observations and went ahead with the trying it out. The place is small, so definitely plan ahead. You will have to wait, so either you know, just do so, or perhaps try to visit outside of peak hours. Luckily, our wait was only about 20 minutes as the dinner rush was just leveling off.

The special was the local rock crab - $25 for 3 lbs of California Rock Crab, salad, and your choice of soup/chowder. After taking a look at a few trays of rock crab being served out, the wife and I both opted for it, as it looked awesome.  

The salad/chowder combo was great as you actually received hearty portions of each, so it was a good start. As much as I liked the chowder however, the Shrimp Bisque the wife ordered was amazing, so I would recommend that going forward. 

But enough of prattling on about side dishes: the rock crab tasted just as glorious as it looked. Juicy, buttery chunks of white crab meat await you, just a few cracks away. While the rock crab shells are pretty thick, once cracked, they splinter and separate easily, a good sign they are cooked to perfection. The rock crabs provided a great amount of meat for what I felt to be the least amount of work you're going to do for crab, King or otherwise. 

We were thoroughly satisfied with our meal and along with the special being an overall great value, devouring the Rock Crab at SBSC turned out to be one of the favorite meals on the trip. I think ordering crab here is a safe proposition indeed.

input: I LOVE Weaver's Way and really disagree with some of the content in previous reviews. WW is not necessarily meant for convenience shopping. I am a single woman and I find that I have no trouble shopping at the co-op, during peak times or otherwise. I actually find the co-op to be a great place to shop if you live alone because I can get smaller quantities of items than if I shop at the corporate stores like Acme. I also enjoy the work hours - I've worked throughout the store, but most recently, I have been getting in my hours by participating in the membership committee. I wouldn't say that the community is necessarily made up of "tree huggers" and "earth children", though. The community is made up of a variety of similarly-minded folks from different backgrounds. I enjoy having a place to go to where I can obtain locally grown produce, a place that offers more natural, wholesome, and preservative-free foods than chain stores with prices way below that of Whole Foods. I enjoy interacting with other members and contributing to my local and global community. I don't find the membership fee or the work hours to be prohibitive being a single person vs. a family. I don't think that membership in a co-op is for everyone and, if you aren't single, it's definitely not a solo decision. If you're keen on being committed to the Weaver Way values, you couldn't find a better place to shop. If not, stick to the chain stores or just pay the 10% visitors' fee to pop in once in a while.
Help me polish this:

Additionally, their prices are reasonable and competitive with those at Whole Foods. The chance to interact with other members and contribute to both the local and global community is incredibly rewarding.

As a single person, I don't find the membership fee or the work hours to be prohibitive, especially when compared to the benefits and values that Weaver's Way offers. However, I understand that joining a co-op may not be suitable for everyone, especially if you're not single. In such cases, sticking to chain stores or paying the 10% visitors' fee to occasionally visit Weaver's Way is a viable option.

If you truly align with the values upheld by Weaver's Way, I can honestly say that there is no better place to shop. Otherwise, I would recommend sticking to chain stores or occasional visits with the visitors' fee.

input: I've only had the cannolis here but they are awesome! They're freshly filled when ordered and the filling is phenomenal. Not too sweet, it's perfect. If you like cannoli, if you don't think you like cannoli, you should definitely get one from Termini Bros.

input:
After living in the STL area for way over 10 years now, I am both ashamed and remorseful to admit that I ate here for the FIRST time just a few weeks ago. I am ashamed because it's a St. Louis tradition and remorseful because I missed out on it for so..many...years! 

This place is amazing. What is not to love! It's a factory where you can get a tour (Friday-Sunday, noon-5pm on the hour), there's a shop, bar, and dining area. They also host many event with live music on the weekends. It's fun to just kind of wander and look around - don't worry, you'll get a chance because there will likely be a wait before you dine. The beer is, of course, amazing. The Hefeweizen is my personal favorite and a great start for anyone who is not a huge beer drinker (like myself). Additionally, the food is homegrown and damn good. I had the pizza (recommendation from my server) and it was really spectacular, though I'm admittedly a pizza connoisseur so I enjoy a good pizza pie more than most probably ;P My date had a bison burger which was also really good. 

More fun info: the service is great! I think they tend to hire more funky and alternative people (like tattoo parlor staff) which I support. The quality is what makes this place stand out along with the emphasis on local food and brewery. 

It is a little on the pricier side but for all the experience you get and the quality, it is worth it. I will go again and again and you probably should, too!

input:

input: My food only merited maybe two stars but I will give an extra star because I like the menu (and will try more of it) and their design and concept.  Sadly though, my tomato-basil soup tasted kind of like a weak marinara and my tuna melt type sandwich had a very sharp, off-putting flavor.  It was citrusy, for sure, and I love lemon in a tuna melt but perhaps this was lemon zest or something just way too overpowering?  I think next time I will focus on the dishes with cured Italian meats, mortadella and prosciutto.  And also the baked goods, those sounded pretty good, especially the Nutella bruschetta!
Help me polish this: Although only deserving two stars, I am inclined to give an additional star due to my appreciation for their menu, which I intend to explore further. Similarly, the tuna melt I ordered had an unpleasant and tangy taste that greatly deterred from my dining experience. While I do appreciate the citrusy aspect, perhaps the addition of lemon zest was overpowering. In my next visit, I plan to shift my attention towards dishes featuring cured Italian meats such as mortadella and prosciutto. Additionally, the baked goods showcased on the menu, particularly the Nutella bruschetta, piqued my interest.

input: We visited once and were very disappointed in my veggie pizza and my husband's sub sandwich.  The tomato sauce was not tasty, and they did not use enough cheese on my pizza. input:
A couple friends and I stopped by for some late night milkshakes and found ourselves at More Than Just Ice Cream. Well, we just got ice cream...not fully taking advantage of what the name implies, but maybe next time.

3 milkshakes: 1 coffee, 1 chocolate, and 1 black&white malt.

The black&white was plenty thick and was probably the best of the three. Unfortunately, I did not order that one so I settled for my not so creamy coffee.

I did sample some ice cream flavors before setting on a milkshake. I tried the pumpkin pie which was AMAZING. I don't know why I didn't just get this. Maybe a milkshake isn't the way to go here.
Help me polish this:

Among the three milkshakes we ordered - one coffee, one chocolate, and one black & white malt - all were quite tasty. While they did satisfy our ice cream fix, I couldn't help but feel that both my coffee and chocolate milkshakes could have been a bit thicker in consistency. On the other hand, the black & white malt was perfectly thick and ultimately the standout of the trio. Unfortunately, I didn't order that one and had to settle for my less-than-creamy coffee shake.

Before deciding on a milkshake, I did sample a few ice cream flavors. The pumpkin pie flavor was absolutely amazing, and in hindsight, I regret not opting for a serving of that instead. It made me think that perhaps a milkshake may not be the best way to fully appreciate the delicious ice cream offerings here.

input:
I visited this restaurant 4 times during my 5 days stay. Crazy, right? Here are a list of reasons/pros:

- We were staying a nearby hotel.
- The restaurant opens 11 - 10:30 pretty much every day including new year's day so it fits into our schedule.
- If you are a party of two, chances are you get seated right away.
- $9 per dozen of oysters which is a really great deal by any standard!
- They have a seafood shop next door that sells boiled and fresh seafood to- go.
- Our server (same) is very friendly and recognized us every single time.

Now I want to talk about the reasons why I only give it 3 stars.

- We tried a bunch of stuff which are all pretty mediocre. Raw oysters are not cleaned well. So if your schedule is flexible, go to Superior Seafood during their happy hours for their 50 cents/oyster - better quality and cheaper. Turtle soup has a strange taste so I definitely prefer Felix's. A portion of my boiled shrimps are always mushy somhow, maybe boiled for too long?...
- The ambient is inviting but not comfortable so we basically just finished our food and go. 
- Clean the bathroom!!

Will probably visit again if we stay in the area next time or simply just pick up some seafood quickly.
Help me polish this:
I visited this restaurant four times during my five-day stay. Crazy, right? Here is a list of reasons/advantages:

- We were staying at a nearby hotel.
- The restaurant opens from 11 am to 10:30 pm almost every day, including New Year's Day, so it conveniently fit into our schedule.
- If you are a party of two, chances are you will be seated right away.
- The price of $9 per dozen oysters is an amazing deal by any standard!
- They have a seafood shop next door that sells both boiled and fresh seafood to-go.
- Our server, who was the same each time, was very friendly and recognized us every single time.

Now, let's discuss the reasons why I gave it only three stars:

- We tried a variety of dishes, but they were all pretty mediocre. The raw oysters were not cleaned well. So, if your schedule is flexible, I recommend going to Superior Seafood during their happy hours for their 50 cents/oyster deal - better quality and cheaper. Additionally, the turtle soup had a strange taste, so I definitely prefer Felix's. Every time I had the boiled shrimp, a portion of them was always mushy, which may indicate they were boiled for too long.
- The ambiance is inviting but not very comfortable, so we usually just finished our food and left.
- The cleanliness of the bathroom needs improvement!

Overall, I would probably visit again if I stay in the area next time or simply pick up some seafood quickly.

input: Skip this train wreck if you are looking for dinner.  Our server was clueless...like we seriously thought she was lost in the restaurant.  Had to ask for setups, water refills, etc.  Ordered chicken parmesan and got eggplant parmesan instead with a fish bone in it.  The drinks were good.
Help me polish this: I would recommend avoiding this establishment if you have dinner plans. Our server appeared completely clueless, to the point where we wondered if she was lost in the restaurant. We had to continuously ask for basics like setups and water refills. To make matters worse, the chicken parmesan we ordered turned out to be eggplant parmesan with a fish bone in it. On a positive note, the drinks were satisfying.

input: Meh is all I can say for TDS. The restaurant itself is just cold.... not literally, but figuratively. There was no decor, no menu boards, stainless steel prep tables as dining tables, no soda machines, staff EVERYWHERE with no identification (shirts, nametags, etc). The food is reasonably priced and most of it was quite good, but what really irked my party was the fact that they charge for extra salsa!!! We ordered a salsa trio (which included 3 samples of the various salsas, in 2oz glass prep bowls), and when my brother asked for more salsa for his tacos (mind you, we ordered one of ever taco, three burritos and guacamole), he was told he'd have to buy the trio again! Really!!??? We spent over $40 on food, drinks and apps, too. Even though the food was decent, I wouldn't return as the atmosphere is just blah and you can't get extra salsa for your damn tacos!
Help me polish this: In my opinion, TDS left me unimpressed. The overall atmosphere of the restaurant was lackluster - there was no decor, no menu boards, and dining tables made of stainless steel prep tables. Additionally, the staff didn't have any visible identification to distinguish themselves. While the food was reasonably priced and mostly delicious, there was one major issue that bothered my party: they charged extra for salsa! We ordered a salsa trio, which came in 2oz glass prep bowls, but when my brother asked for more salsa for his tacos, he was told he had to purchase the trio again. This seemed unreasonable considering the amount of food we ordered, including one of every taco, three burritos, and guacamole. We spent over $40 on our meal and even though the food was decent, I don't think I would return to TDS due to the uninspiring atmosphere and the disappointment of being denied extra salsa for our tacos.

input: I'm so incredibly happy with our pictures! Angela Clifton Photography have worked with us 3 times and we have been happy with every single picture that was taken! Not only are the photos fabulous, but we had such a fun experience. The price is extremely reasonable and the pictures will be a keepsake we will cherish forever!
Help me polish this: I am absolutely thrilled with the outcome of our pictures! input: Enjoyed my fish out at a sidewalk table.  A bit pricey but food was good.  Go to Side street in French quarter if u want quieter dining outside.
Help me polish this: I thoroughly enjoyed my meal, dining at a sidewalk table with a beautiful ambiance. Though the prices were a bit high, the food was undeniably excellent. If you prefer a quieter outdoor dining experience, I highly recommend visiting Side Street in the French Quarter.

input: The court house is very old and the art is great. The spiral staircase is funny. One can get view of entire city from 5th level. The tower clock room is really surprising with all mechanical gears inside!! You need a prior appointment to get into clock room. Worth spending 2 to 3 hours of time here.
Help me polish this:
The courthouse is a truly remarkable sight, with its ancient architecture and stunning art pieces. As you ascend the spiral staircase, a sense of whimsy fills the air, making it an enjoyable experience. Once you reach the 5th level, a breathtaking panoramic view of the entire city awaits, rewarding you for the climb.

However, the true gem lies within the tower clock room, an unexpected surprise. As you step inside, you'll find yourself surrounded by an intricate network of mechanical gears, beautifully crafted and mesmerizing to behold. It's important to note that accessing the clock room requires a prior appointment, but the effort is undoubtedly worthwhile.

Allow yourself a generous amount of time, perhaps 2 to 3 hours, to fully immerse yourself in the courthouse's wonders. Whether you choose to appreciate the art, explore the spiral staircase, take in the magnificent view, or marvel at the fascinating clock room, each moment spent here is bound to be unforgettable.

input: I had the pleasure to meet with Ann today and not only was she extremely helpful and so positive, she went above and beyond to make my 1st experience here amazing and made it a absolute regular customer from this day forward. Thanks girlie!!
Help me polish this: I had the pleasure of meeting Ann today, and I have to say, she was incredibly helpful and positive. She went above and beyond to make my first experience here amazing, and as a result, she has gained a loyal customer from this day forward. Thank you so much, Ann! You're fantastic!

input: This is the first time I tried this place and  I was surprisingly surprised. I had a combination dinner pad Thai and coconut soup. The soup was very tasty as I never had coconut soup before. The pad Thai was exactly what I was expecting and it did not disappoint. The restaurant had great Thai decor and music. The staff and service was top notch. For a town with not much selection for food, this was a great change of pace. This may become my go to place in Carp.
Help me polish this:
This was my first experience at this place, and to say that I was pleasantly surprised would be an understatement. I opted for the combination dinner, which included pad Thai and coconut soup. The soup, being something I had never tried before, exceeded all my expectations with its delectable taste. As for the pad Thai, it was exactly what I had anticipated and definitely lived up to its reputation.

Not only did the food impress me, but the restaurant itself exuded an authentic Thai ambiance, complete with tasteful decor and charming music. The staff and service were nothing short of excellent, providing top-notch hospitality throughout my visit. In a town with limited dining options, this hidden gem proved to be a refreshing change of pace.

Needless to say, this may very well become my new go-to spot in Carp.

input: This place was so chill and relaxing. When I come back it'll definitely be in my list if stops. Not to mention the artist performing was fun and eclectic  (I mean really, a country version of "Let It Go", what's not to love?)
Help me polish this: This place was incredibly serene and calming. It will definitely be at the top of my list when I come back. The artist performing added an extra touch of enjoyment and diversity. I mean, seriously, who would have thought a country rendition of "Let It Go"? It was simply delightful and impossible not to adore.

input:
Id you haven't been to the Smoothie King center since it was know as the New Orleans Arena, you are in for a nice surprise. The arena has had a face lift and, while the seats are the same,  everything else has been refreshed.   

Most importantly,  the food options are far more varied and appeal to many tastes.  The quality of the food is very good and significantly improved from a few years back. The drink options are much improved as well and include full service bars, spiked lemonade,  bottled and draft beer and of course, smoothies.  There is even a spot for sweets. You can get funnel cake, cotton candy, and all kinds of delicious things I was too full to take in.  

The venue finally feels a bit swanky and top notch.  We are moving on up!
Help me polish this:
If you haven't visited the Smoothie King Center since its transformation from the New Orleans Arena, get ready for a pleasant surprise. The arena has undergone a significant facelift, rejuvenating its appearance to create a fresh and vibrant atmosphere.

While the seating remains unchanged, everything else has been revitalized to enhance your overall experience. One of the most noteworthy improvements lies in the expanded array of food options available, catering to a wide range of tastes. The quality of the cuisine has undergone a marked improvement, leaving behind the subpar standards of previous years.

Additionally, the beverage selection has seen substantial enhancements. With the inclusion of full-service bars and an assortment of enticing drinks such as spiked lemonade and a variety of bottled and draft beers, there is something to satisfy every thirst. Of course, the star of the show remains the smoothies, a refreshing and delicious choice for attendees. And if you're craving something sweet, there's even a dedicated spot offering mouthwatering treats like funnel cake, cotton candy, and an assortment of other delectable goodies.

Overall, the revamped venue exudes an air of sophistication and high quality, elevating the experience to a whole new level. It's clear that we are wonderfully progressing in a positive direction.

input: Don't know what it is but If my tummy's feeling icky, I can count on Chipotle's stake to fix me up. I just have to remember not to go during full on lunch time. I usually go between 2 & 4 when it's peaceful and calm. Busy or not the service is always friendly and fast!
Help me polish this: Don't know what it is, but whenever my tummy feels icky, Chipotle's stake never fails to fix me right up. The trick is to avoid going during peak lunch hours; I've learned that going between 2 and 4 in the afternoon ensures a peaceful and calm dining experience. Regardless of how busy they may be, Chipotle's service is consistently friendly and fast!

input: I must admit, I wasn't expecting much. This place totally blew us away. This has to be one of the best Indian restaurants in the Tampa Bay. The ambience is wonderful including white table linens. The best part was the food, OMG. The chicken 65 was to die for, and the hot sour soup was rich and flavorful. The waitress (Angel) was friendly,  attentive and very pleasant. They opened just a week ago. I'm sure this will soon be the place foodies seek out for real Indian food.
Help me polish this: I must admit, my expectations weren't high. However, this place completely exceeded them. Without a doubt, it ranks among the top Indian restaurants in the Tampa Bay area. The ambience is exquisite, with elegant white table linens that add to the overall experience. Yet, the true highlight was the food – simply outstanding. The Chicken 65 was exceptionally delicious, leaving us craving for more. Moreover, the hot sour soup was bursting with rich, flavorful goodness. Our waitress, Angel, was incredibly friendly and attentive, making our dining experience even more enjoyable. It's hard to believe this establishment only opened a week ago. I'm confident that soon enough, it will become the go-to spot for food enthusiasts searching for authentic Indian cuisine.

input:
Had to wait until my third trip to NOLA to actually get in the door.  First two times I tried waiting in line, this time around we got smart and bought reserved seats so we could be on the benches. Well worth the extra $20 to not hassle with waiting in line for an hour. It goes toward the preservation of Jazz so it's a good cause...just splurge.

The show was fantastic.  True musicians and great personalities to boot. I can only imagine that this is what concerts were like 50 years ago. The band members were dapper, engaging and insanely talented.  It's in a tiny hole in the wall space that only holds maybe 200 people? So it's very intimate and nice to see the smiles on the faces of the musicians as they share their craft with you. This is a must do while in NOLA!
Help me polish this:
After waiting in line on two separate occasions, I finally managed to step foot inside the door of NOLA on my third visit. Determined to avoid the hassle this time, we opted to purchase reserved seats, allowing us to comfortably bask on the benches. The additional $20 proved to be a worthwhile investment, not only sparing us from an hour-long wait, but also contributing to the preservation of Jazz, making it a commendable cause to support.

The show itself was nothing short of extraordinary. The musicians not only showcased their remarkable talent but also exuded captivating personalities. It felt as though I had been transported back to concerts from half a century ago. Sporting elegant attire, the band members were engaging and their skills were downright incredible. Taking place in a cozy, hole-in-the-wall venue that can accommodate a mere 200 individuals, the intimate setting allowed for genuine connections to form between the audience and the musicians. Witnessing the joy on their faces as they shared their craft was truly heartwarming. If you find yourself in NOLA, this experience is an absolute must-do.

input: A GREAT EXPERIENCE!!!!!!!!!  I was a completely new customer.  I did not have an appointment because my other plans got rained out and my dealership was too busy to take me.  I needed a PA State & Emissions  inspection which I dread because they can be a total ripoff at some places when they add things on and I just wanted to get it over with.  I saw that this place had much better reviews on Yelp than many other shops in the area.  Keystone Discount Tire took my 2008 Pontiac Torrent in for inspection while I waited and had some free coffee.  I only had to get up once to look at some irregular outer front tire wear on my car when it was on the rack during inspection.  I always appreciate it when the technician lets me look at the problem.   It was nothing major.  Easily correctable with an alignment sometime in the future.  Bill was very friendly, knowledgable, and straightforward with his overall analysis of my car.  My car was fully inspected and stickered in less than an hour without my bill being jacked up with add-ons.   I recommend getting on their mailing list for their coupons!!!!!!!!!!
Help me polish this:
An Amazing Experience!

As a first-time customer, I found myself without an appointment due to unforeseen circumstances. Unable to visit my regular dealership, which was too busy, I needed a PA State & Emissions inspection. I usually dread these inspections as some places tend to add unnecessary expenses. However, after seeing the excellent reviews on Yelp, I decided to give Keystone Discount Tire a try.

Upon arrival, I was promptly attended to, and my 2008 Pontiac Torrent was taken in for inspection while I waited comfortably, enjoying a complimentary cup of coffee. The only time I had to stand up was to inspect some irregular outer front tire wear on my vehicle when it was on the rack. I always appreciate it when technicians involve me in the process, and I was relieved to find that the issue was nothing major. The technician assured me that it could easily be corrected with a future alignment.

Bill, the technician, went above and beyond to provide a friendly, knowledgeable, and straightforward analysis of my car. In less than an hour, my car was fully inspected and stickered without any surprise charges. I was relieved that my bill was not jacked up with unnecessary add-ons, making the entire process hassle-free.

Lastly, I highly recommend signing up for their mailing list to receive coupons and discounts. It's a great way to save some money on their already impressive services.

input: Wow! I never thought my sons phone could be repaired after he dropped it but it is and it took less than a half an hour! Very professional and excellent service! I'm thrilled!
Help me polish this: Wow! I am truly amazed by the fact that my son's phone could be repaired after he dropped it. Even more impressive is the speed of the repair, which was completed in less than half an hour! The level of professionalism and quality of service provided were outstanding. I couldn't be happier with the outcome!

input: Service and management terrible... After messing up all 4 of our orders the waiter got mad and started cursing... The manager offered our drinks to be free.. What a mess. The food was cold and nasty didn't even eat half of it and waited over an hour... I will never dine in any cracker barrel again after this experience...
Help me polish this:
I had an extremely disappointing experience at a Cracker Barrel outlet recently. The service and management were nothing short of terrible. To make matters worse, our orders were completely messed up, not just once, but four times in a row. Our waiter, instead of acknowledging the mistake and apologizing, actually got angry and resorted to cursing at us, which was completely unprofessional.

In an attempt to salvage the situation, the manager offered to comp our drinks, but it was far from enough to rectify the overall dissatisfaction. Not only was the service abysmal, but the food itself was cold and unappetizing. In fact, the quality was so poor that we couldn't even bring ourselves to finish half of what was served to us. And to make matters even worse, we had to endure an hour-long wait before we even received our meals.

Needless to say, this experience has left a lasting negative impression on me, and as a result, I have decided to never dine at any Cracker Barrel establishment again. The lack of accountability, the subpar food, and the overall mismanagement have completely turned me off from ever giving them another chance.

input:
I have been to a number of dog friendly hotels...just not in the city and did not know what to expect. Usually they are motel like.  This one was in the heart of the city.

I walked tentatively into the hotel lobby as i have a labrador/golden mix who is not easy to hide.

We got to the front desk to register and i was still feeling uneasy although my  bf had assured me it was a dog friendly hotel. Reception was so nice immediately putting us at ease. As we checked in an attendant asked if Bentley could have treats which she fullly enjoyed. The Reception person also asked if we would like a welcome kit for Bentley. Holy moly. Of course. Dog dishes, a mat, treats, etc. I was blown away.  

Plus the guests at the hotel all stopped to compliment and pet "queen Bentley". Our room was on the top floor. Awesome!

Even when i went to walk her the car attendants greeted her by name. We were so impressed with the service we decided to come back an extra night. 

Thank you Loews. I didnt realize a hotel could be so dog friendly especially to a big dog.
Help me polish this:
I have had the opportunity to stay at several dog-friendly hotels before, but they were typically located outside of the city, and their amenities were rather basic. However, my recent experience at a centrally located hotel truly exceeded my expectations.

Upon entering the lobby, I felt a sense of uncertainty, as my Labrador/Golden mix is not easy to conceal. However, the reception staff immediately made us feel welcome and at ease. While checking in, one of the attendants even asked if Bentley, my four-legged companion, would like some treats. Needless to say, Bentley thoroughly enjoyed that gesture. Furthermore, they offered us a welcome kit specifically tailored to Bentley's needs, complete with dog dishes, a mat, and treats. To say that I was impressed would be an understatement.

Not only did the hotel staff make us feel at home, but the other guests were equally welcoming. Many of them took the time to compliment and affectionately pet Bentley, treating her like royalty. Our room, located on the top floor, offered breathtaking views and added to the overall positive experience.

Even when I took Bentley for walks, the car attendants greeted her by name, further demonstrating the exceptional service provided by the hotel. We were so thoroughly impressed with our stay that we decided to extend our visit by an additional night.

I cannot express my gratitude enough to Loews for creating an environment that is truly dog-friendly, even for larger breeds like Bentley. My preconceived notions about dog-friendly hotels have been completely shattered by this delightful experience.

input: Sometimes this food is very very good.  Unfortunately it's not consistent.   Ordered something I've been getting for years and every other time it tastes incredible. It's like they have different people in the kitchen and you don't know who you will get. So 50 % of the time it's excellent.  UGH.
Help me polish this: Sometimes the food here is absolutely delicious, but regrettably, the consistency is lacking. I've been ordering a particular dish for years, and while it is usually outstanding, the experience can vary greatly. It seems as though there are different individuals in the kitchen, resulting in unpredictability. Consequently, about half of the time, the dish is excellent. It's undoubtedly frustrating.

input:
Been to this location twice and will never go back again!!!!

First time was mediocre, the second time was so very disappointing it beggars belief. I ordered some ribs and had to send them back because one half was warm and the other half was refrigerator cold. They came back and one side was really hot and the other side was still cold, third time it was edible. The manager came over the third time to apologize, never once offered to comp anything. I'm not the kind of guy to cause a fuss to get something comped, but to send something back three times to get it cooked properly and only get an insincere apology really pisses me off, enough for me to write this review.
Help me polish this:
I have had the unfortunate experience of visiting this location twice, and I can confidently say that I will never return again. The initial visit was just average, but the second time around was beyond disappointing, leaving me utterly perplexed. I had ordered a serving of ribs which turned out to be a complete disappointment. One half of the ribs were warm, while the other half remained refrigerator cold. After sending them back, I received the same dish with one side scalding hot and the other side still cold. It took three attempts before I finally received a plate of ribs that was deemed edible.

To add insult to injury, the manager finally made an appearance during the third exchange, offering a mere apology without any gesture to compensate for the series of mishaps. I am not the type to make a scene in order to obtain freebies, but enduring the ordeal of sending back my meal three times only to receive a half-hearted apology truly infuriates me. This disappointment has driven me to write this review, as I feel it is important to share my experience.

input:
After trying a few ramen places with crazy variety in their selections and stellar broth, I was not too excited about the ramen I got at Cheu.  Maybe it's a matter of taste, but personally, I was not a fan of their thick noodles, and extremely salty broth.  

The service was great, and they had a nice selection of beers!  The friend I went with loved it, and has been many times.  Honestly, I'm just sorry I wasn't a bigger fan.  But I hope others try it for themselves.  I might just be an oddball out on this one.
Help me polish this:
After exploring several ramen spots with an incredible range of options and exceptional broth, I found myself underwhelmed by my experience at Cheu. Perhaps it's a subjective matter, but personally, I didn't enjoy their thick noodles and excessively salty broth. 

However, it's worth noting that the service at Cheu was fantastic, and they offered an impressive variety of beers. My companion, who has frequented the restaurant numerous times, thoroughly enjoyed their meal. I sincerely regret not sharing the same enthusiasm. Nevertheless, I encourage others to try it out and form their own opinion, as my taste preferences might be a bit unconventional in this case.

input:

input:
Looks like there is a second Red Kings restaurant in Chinatown and it did not disappoint! Since this place just opened yesterday, I'm not exactly sure if it's replacing the other Red Kings down the street, or if it is just a second helping of spicy, Szechuan food.

We ordered takeout and picked up the Dan Dan Noodles and a shredded Pork in Garlic sauce dish. The spice level in both dishes was perfect.  Extremely mouth-burning, but with delicious flavors that were sweet, earthy, and fresh. The portions were very generous and will make for great leftovers for us. I can't wait to try some of the other dishes and come back here for a sit-down dinner. They also have karaoke rooms upstairs, plus they are BYOB.
Help me polish this:
It looks like there is another Red Kings restaurant in Chinatown, and it did not disappoint! Since this establishment just opened yesterday, I'm not quite sure if it's meant to replace the other Red Kings nearby or if it's simply a delightful addition of spicy, Szechuan cuisine.

We opted for takeout and selected the Dan Dan Noodles and a dish of shredded Pork in Garlic sauce. Both dishes presented the perfect level of spiciness. They were incredibly flavorful, with a delightful blend of sweetness, earthiness, and freshness. The portions were impressively large and will undoubtedly provide us with delectable leftovers. I am eagerly anticipating the opportunity to explore their other dishes and return for a sit-down dinner. Additionally, they offer karaoke rooms upstairs, and it's worth mentioning that it's a BYOB establishment.

input: This is one of the busiest Chick fil A's I've seen but they always manage to be quick and have exceptional service! I seriously don't know how they can be so quick and great all the time! One of my favorite places!
Help me polish this: This Chick-fil-A location stands out as one of the busiest I have ever encountered. Despite the constant hustle and bustle, they consistently provide exceptional service and deliver quick service.
