input: Nothing extraordinary, but if you want some simple Chinese takeout, this is the best place around. The food seems less greasy than you sometimes find and the people are super nice.
Help me polish this: If you're craving a no-fuss Chinese takeout experience, look no further than this hidden gem. While it may not offer anything out of the ordinary, this place undeniably serves the best simple Chinese fare in town. Standout from the competition, their dishes boast a noticeably lighter and less greasy touch. Moreover, the friendly and accommodating staff add an extra touch of warmth to your whole dining experience.

input: Quaint place with great ambience, food and service. I had the Shrimp Po Boy. It was delicious. The fries and cole slaw were perfect side dishes. This was my first visit. Definitely not my last.
Help me polish this: I had an absolutely delightful experience at this charming establishment, which boasts a delightful ambience, delectable cuisine, and impeccable service. Upon my visit, I indulged in the mouthwatering Shrimp Po Boy, which left me thoroughly satisfied with its burst of flavors. Accompanying it were the flawlessly executed fries and cole slaw, serving as the perfect complement to the main dish. My initial visit to this establishment was nothing short of exceptional, and it has undoubtedly earned its place as a regular haunt for me in the future.

input: Broussard's was pretty good when I went there a few weeks ago. I had a Groupon that was about to expire so I took my parents out to dinner.  I knew going in that Broussards is a very old skool New Orleans restaurant, and it is very nice when you walk in to see the old tile on the walls in the foyer of the building. The courtyard is beautiful and I just had to turn into a tourist and take a picture in front of the fountain with my mom. We were seated and very promptly greeted by the drink guy.  He brought us our water and told us about the extensive wine list, but they were of course out of the Pinot Grigio that I ordered.  He successfully suggested a Chardonnay for me instead and I was happy. The head waiter came out and explained with great detail the specials for the night, but I went for menu regulars, the maytag blue cheese salad and the pecan crusted drum. I wanted more salad, it was so good, I ate it up so fast. The drum was excellent too. It had this soy butter sauce on it that was so good and topped with crawfish. I was definitely happy with my meal and glad I had the experience. What makes me knock off two stars is that though the foyer's vintage appeal is nice and the courtyard is beautiful, I feel like the dining room needs an upgrade.  The chandeliers on the walls in the main dining room are very reminiscent of the hallways of my grandmother's assisted living home. I think its just one of those places I am glad to say I've been to, but I don't think I will choose to go there again.
Help me polish this:
Broussard's was an enjoyable experience when I visited a few weeks ago. I had a Groupon that was approaching its expiration date, so I decided to take my parents out for dinner. Being aware of Broussard's reputation as a traditional New Orleans restaurant, I was delighted to see the vintage tile on the foyer walls upon arrival. The courtyard was exceptionally beautiful, and I couldn't resist capturing a touristy moment by taking a photo with my mom in front of the fountain.

As we were seated, the drink server promptly greeted us and provided us with water. Although they didn't have the Pinot Grigio I initially ordered, he made a fantastic suggestion for a Chardonnay that left me quite satisfied. The head waiter then came out and passionately explained the nightly specials in great detail. However, I decided to stick with the tried-and-true menu options – the maytag blue cheese salad and the pecan crusted drum. The salad was so delectable that I devoured it in no time, and the drum exceeded my expectations. The blend of soy butter sauce and crawfish atop the drum was simply divine. Overall, I was pleased with my meal and thoroughly enjoyed the experience.

My reason for deducting two stars lies in the need for an upgrade in the dining room. While the vintage charm in the foyer and the courtyard is delightful, I found the main dining room lacking in comparison. The chandeliers lining the walls reminded me too much of the hallways in my grandmother's assisted living home. While I appreciate having had the opportunity to dine at Broussard's, I don't foresee myself choosing to return in the future.

input:
Service is excellent. Atmosphere is great. The raw bar was fantastic. Those were the best Alaskan crab legs I've had. Well worth splurging for them. 

My friends were drawn in by the awesome looking burger they had, and indeed the burgers were all they hoped for. It came with a generous portion of crispy fries. But if you want anything else besides the $17 burgers, expect to spend over $30 for your entree. While the ambience feels and looks casual, it is fine dining.

Unfortunately, the waiter did sell the shrimp and grits with the additional crab as "heaven in his mouth", but that it was not. I've had better shrimp and grits in Atlanta, and there is no reasonable way you should be paying $30 for shrimp and GRITS. Without the crab, it was still over $20.

But everything else was great. Drinks were delicious. Everything came out pretty quickly. Oh, when we mentioned we were visiting from out of town, the waiter was nice enough to give us a complimentary appetizer of the cool pizza to start. It was great but the name is hard to say or remember. And the rabbit and chicken liver pate was super worth since it comes in a huge mason jar.

I recommend sticking to the drinks, appetizers, and burgers and you'll be a pretty happy camper.
Help me polish this:
The service at this establishment is truly exceptional. The atmosphere is delightful, contributing to an overall enjoyable experience. The raw bar offered an outstanding selection, and the Alaskan crab legs in particular surpassed any I have tasted before. They are definitely worth indulging in, even if they come at a higher price point.

Furthermore, my friends were enticed by the visually appealing burgers they saw, and they were not disappointed. These burgers lived up to their expectations, accompanied by a generous serving of crisp, delicious fries. However, it is important to note that if you opt for anything other than the $17 burgers, be prepared to spend over $30 for your main course. Despite having a relaxed appearance, the ambiance is indeed that of a fine dining establishment.

Regrettably, the waiter oversold the shrimp and grits dish by recommending it as "heaven in his mouth," but it did not live up to this claim. I have had superior shrimp and grits in Atlanta, and paying $30 for shrimp and GRITS seems unreasonable. Even without the addition of crab, the dish still surpassed $20 in price.

Nonetheless, everything else about the experience was superb. The drinks were incredibly tasty, and the delivery of each course was prompt. On a side note, when we mentioned that we were visiting from out of town, the waiter kindly treated us to a complimentary appetizer: the delicious but hard-to-pronounce or remember pizza. Additionally, the rabbit and chicken liver pate, served in a large mason jar, was an excellent choice and well worth ordering.

In conclusion, my recommendation would be to focus on the drinks, appetizers, and burgers for a truly satisfying dining experience. By doing so, you will leave as a content and gratified customer.

input: I love Doan's. It's the kind of place you have a "usual" and every time you have it, it's just as good as the last time. They staff is friendly and speedy so if you don't have a long lunch it's a great place to go.
Help me polish this: I absolutely adore Doan's! It's that kind of place where you can't help but have a "usual," and each time you indulge in it, the experience is equally delightful. The staff is incredibly friendly and efficient, making it a perfect choice for a quick lunch when you're pressed for time.

input: This amazing brick oven pizza joint gets better every time I go. The last I time I went I got a Rotolo and a prosciutto pizza. The Rotolo is dough wrapped around mortadella and ricotta cheese and topped with pistachios and oil. It is so good. I order it every time. It's about the size of a bun and cost $5. The pizza was amazing. The prosciutto was incredibly tasty. The dough is divine. The service is always great and the beer selection is good. Definitely one of the best pizza places in Philly.
Help me polish this:
I am continuously impressed with this extraordinary brick oven pizza joint every time I visit. During my last visit, I indulged in a delectable Rotolo and a scrumptious prosciutto pizza. The Rotolo, featuring dough enveloping mortadella and ricotta cheese, embellished with pistachios and oil, is an absolute delight. I am completely hooked and cannot resist ordering it every time I visit. With a size similar to that of a bun, it is reasonably priced at just $5.

The pizza itself was simply exceptional. The prosciutto topping was bursting with flavor, while the dough was divine in its texture and taste. The consistent, top-notch service and impressive beer selection only add to the overall dining experience. Without a doubt, this place earns its spot as one of the finest pizza establishments in Philadelphia.

input:
Amazing pizza. AMAZING! After my first bite, I felt like that Oprah Winfrey meme, where her head is thrown back, her mouth is agape and her arms are open wide, and she's screaming, "You get a car!" Except it's not Oprah, it's me. And I don't get a car -- I get a pizza. But I felt that excited.  

This is basically the pizza I have been looking for since moving to the Indianapolis area. It's a whole lot of nothing: It's not cut into square pieces. It's not crispy and thin. It's not redolent of oregano. It's thick and chewy, cheesy, greasy, wonderful -- it tastes the way pizza is supposed to taste! I have found my new pizza home.
Help me polish this:
In one word: extraordinary. EXTRAORDINARY! From the very first bite, I was overcome with sheer delight, much like the iconic Oprah Winfrey meme. You know the one, with her head thrown back, mouth agape, arms wide open, and screaming, "You get a car!" Well, picture that, but with me, only it's not a car I'm receiving, it's a pizza. Yet, I felt that same level of excitement and exhilaration.

This is the pizza I have been tirelessly searching for ever since I moved to the vibrant city of Indianapolis. It surpasses expectations in every way imaginable. It defies conventional norms: it's not cut into mundane square pieces, it doesn't boast a thin and crispy profile, and it isn't overwhelmed by the scent of oregano. No, this pizza is something entirely different. It is a thick and chewy masterpiece, generously laden with melted cheese and delectably greasy. It captures the essence of what pizza should taste like, embodying true culinary perfection.

I have stumbled upon my pizza nirvana, my haven, my new home.

input: Waited 27 minutes for three teas (no one else was in the store when we came in and ordered). NO tea is worth that long of a wait, especially in Chinatown.
Help me polish this: We had to wait for a frustratingly long 27 minutes to receive our order of three teas, even though there were no other customers present in the store at the time we came in. In a bustling place like Chinatown, waiting that much time for just a few cups of tea feels incredibly excessive and not worth it.

input:
I grew up eating beef sandwiches in Chicago, and this place makes the best beef I've ever had outside of the city. 

Couple of suggestions: Offer a third sandwich size option (bigger!), get sweet peppers, serve fries(!!!), keep the main location off of Mass Ave open year-round, and have longer hours!
Help me polish this:
Having grown up eating beef sandwiches in Chicago, I must say that this place truly makes the best beef I've ever had outside of the city. However, I have a few suggestions that could make the experience even better.

Firstly, it would be fantastic if there was a third sandwich size option available, perhaps a larger one for those of us with a big appetite. Additionally, I highly recommend adding sweet peppers to the menu, as they complement the beef sandwiches perfectly.

Another improvement would be to offer a side of fries to go along with the sandwiches. The combination of beef and fries is a classic that would surely delight customers.

Furthermore, I urge you to consider keeping the main location off of Mass Ave open year-round. Many of us would love to enjoy your delicious beef sandwiches even during the colder months.

Lastly, extending the operating hours would be greatly appreciated. It would allow more people to experience your amazing beef sandwiches and satisfy their cravings at all times of the day.

Overall, these suggestions would not only enhance the current experience but also make your establishment even more appealing to both locals and visitors alike.

input:
We came here for an early mothers day celebration as we were on the quest to find a nail salon that could accommodate 4 pedicures at the same time. They were very friendly and even though they didn't have 4 pedicurists on the schedule that day they added one to accommodate us. That was really nice of them as they could have easily told us no. 

The place itself is decorated very modern and offers a very clean, minimalist atmosphere. Upon walking in we were immediately greeted and after we checked in with the front desk we were asked what we wanted to drink. They had complimentary mimosas, wine and champagne, the perfect way to begin to unwind. Once we picked out our polish colors we were well on our way to getting our pedicures. Everyone was so nice and made us feel comfortable and welcomed. My polish never chipped the whole time I had it on. I will definitely be back. 

The only downside is that its street parking only, which isn't something that they can control. They told us most of their business comes from people who work in the CBD so parking probably isn't an issue for their regular customers. Aside from parking being an issue I would definitely go to Buff again.
Help me polish this:
We chose to come here for an early Mother's Day celebration, specifically searching for a nail salon that could accommodate four pedicures simultaneously. Despite not having four pedicurists scheduled that day, the staff was incredibly friendly and went out of their way to accommodate us by adding an extra pedicurist. We truly appreciated this gesture, as they easily could have turned us away.

The salon itself has a modern and stylish decor, creating a clean and minimalist atmosphere. As soon as we walked in, we were warmly greeted, and upon checking in at the front desk, we were offered a selection of complimentary mimosas, wine, and champagne. These refreshing beverages were the perfect start to our relaxation journey. Once we chose our polish colors, the pedicures began, and everyone involved made sure we felt comfortable and welcomed throughout the entire experience. Remarkably, my polish stayed chip-free during the entire time I had it on. I will definitely be returning in the future.

The only downside to this salon is that it only offers street parking, an issue beyond their control. However, they informed us that most of their regular customers are individuals who work in the Central Business District, so parking is usually not a problem for them. Aside from this minor inconvenience, I would highly recommend Buff and will certainly visit again.

input: Great spot for pho! Broth is very good. I ordered No. 51 (small) and it was filling. Would definitely come back again when I'm in Philly.
Help me polish this: This place is an excellent spot for pho! The broth is simply delicious. I went with the small size and chose No. 51, and it was incredibly satisfying. I will definitely be returning whenever I find myself in Philly again.

input:
I love the concept of this place. One half of it a café that serves different types of coffees and teas, and breakfast type items, and the other world where it serves bar type apps, salads, and sandwiches,  Can't forget that they also serve a wide variety of beers that they serve on tap, bottled, or in can.  

This place is pretty darn casual, and one can hang out here for hours with their friends.  Reminds me of the good ol' college days when no time could pass especially on a chill out Sunday Fun day.

Bring your four legged friend too.  They are totally welcome.
Help me polish this:
I absolutely adore the concept of this place! On one side, it's a delightful café offering a diverse range of coffees, teas, and breakfast options. On the other side, it transforms into a world of bar-style apps, salads, and sandwiches. Let's not forget about the wide selection of beers available on tap, in bottles, or cans.

The atmosphere is wonderfully laid-back, making it the perfect spot to spend hours catching up with friends. It truly takes me back to the good ol' college days when time seemed to stand still, especially on a relaxing Sunday Fun day.

The best part? You can even bring your furry four-legged friend along! They are more than welcome here.

input: My husband reserved a Corolla-sized car over the internet ten days ahead of time. When we arrived at Avis Rent A Car at the Reno airport I asked if the rental could be upgraded to a Camry-size vehicle. They offered us two different kinds of cars and finally we got the Camry we wanted. The man was very professional and in the end told us the rental would be $800.00 for five days. I felt the price was very high, however we had gone through most of the paperwork. I had already selected to get the $25.00 a day insurance which came to $150.00 with tax. We were very happy with the car and had no problems with it. During our vacation I decided to talk to an Avis representative when we dropped the car off. I asked her if a weekly rate would be less expensive. She said it would be $15.00 more. She said the upgrade cost an extra $20.00 a day. I will not rent from Avis any more. Next time I will go to Hertz or Dollar and make the reservation over the phone. Looking back, i would not have gotten the extra insurance. My personal insurance covers everything.
Help me polish this: My husband had made an online reservation for a car the size of a Corolla, a whole ten days in advance. Upon our arrival at Avis Rent A Car at the Reno airport, I inquired about the possibility of upgrading to a larger vehicle, specifically a Camry. After considering two different options, we finally managed to secure the Camry we desired. The Avis representative was exceptionally professional, informing us that the rental would cost $800.00 for a five-day period. Although I found this price to be quite steep, we had already completed most of the paperwork. Notably, I had already opted for the $25.00 per day insurance, amounting to $150.00 including tax. Despite the high cost, we were pleased with the car and encountered no issues during our vacation. However, before returning the car, I decided to approach an Avis representative to inquire about a possibly cheaper weekly rate. Unfortunately, I was told that such a rate would actually be $15.00 more expensive. Additionally, it was revealed that the upgrade we had requested cost an extra $20.00 per day. Consequently, I have made the decision to refrain from renting from Avis in the future. Instead, I plan to make reservations over the phone with either Hertz or Dollar. In hindsight, I realize that I wouldn't have needed the additional insurance as my personal coverage already provides comprehensive protection.

input: Great customer service! Love my new car! Highly recommend to anyone who's trying to buy a new used car in good shape! Talk to Andy if you want some good help!
Help me polish this: Exceptional customer service! I am absolutely delighted with my recent car purchase! I highly recommend this dealership to anyone in search of a reliable used vehicle in excellent condition. For top-notch assistance, I strongly urge you to seek out Andy.

input: After moving to the area, Jungle Prada Tavern was one of the first places a friend took me.  The bartender made a great recommendation based on a beer I told her I liked and I loved it!  Now for the food- I LOVE seafood, so I am leary of ordering from places that don't do it justice, but alas, they impressed me thoroughly with all the seafood options I chose!!  The scallops prosciutto app, del mar pizza with crab and scallops, and crab stuffed portabella app (comes with a crab and lobster bisque- YUM) are all delicious!!  I also love the roasted portabella app- for a vegetarian option, it is delicious and was recomended by someone who isn't. I've actually gone back several times since then just to eat (obviously, I also drank ;) and took my sister when she was in town visiting (and is a seafood fanatic).  So all in all, give this place a chance!!  You will not be disappointed with the options!
Help me polish this: After relocating to the area, I was introduced to Jungle Prada Tavern by a friend, and it quickly became one of my favorite spots. The bartender expertly recommended a beer based on my preferences, and I instantly fell in love with it. As a seafood enthusiast, I am typically wary of ordering seafood from unfamiliar places. However, I was pleasantly surprised by the incredible variety of seafood options at this tavern. From the mouthwatering scallops prosciutto appetizer to the tantalizing del mar pizza topped with crab and scallops, every dish exceeded my expectations. The crab stuffed portabella appetizer, which is served with a delectable crab and lobster bisque, was a true delight. Even the roasted portabella appetizer, despite being a vegetarian option, was recommended by a non-vegetarian and turned out to be absolutely delicious. I have revisited Jungle Prada Tavern multiple times solely to savor their exquisite dishes (and, of course, enjoy some drinks). When my seafood-loving sister visited, I eagerly took her there, and she, too, was blown away by the incredible options. Trust me, give this place a chance – you won't be disappointed with the incredible selection they offer!

input: This is one of my favorite bead stores in Nashville, walls and walls of seed beads and glass strands!
Help me polish this: This is hands down one of the best bead stores in Nashville. Once you step inside, you'll be captivated by the sight of countless walls adorned with a dazzling array of seed beads and glass strands. It's a bead lover's paradise!

input: Went here for dinner on opening day and was SO HAPPY I DID!! Great atmosphere, lovely staff, and food on fleek!! Green tea (PHO PHREE) was so satisfying, summer rolls and spicy peanut sauce were DELISH, and pho was PHONOMENAL! Definitely making this one of my regular hot spotz as I eat my way through Fairmount!
Help me polish this: I had the pleasure of dining here on opening day and I must say, I was absolutely thrilled with the experience! The atmosphere was fantastic, the staff was delightful, and let's not forget about the food - it was on another level! The green tea (PHO PHREE) was incredibly satisfying, the summer rolls paired with the spicy peanut sauce were absolutely divine, and the pho... oh my goodness, it was beyond words, simply PHONOMENAL! Without a doubt, I will be adding this gem to my list of regular hot spots as I continue to explore the culinary delights of Fairmount!

input:
Don't let the outside fool ya or even the initial impression when you walk in because they food here is really good! When ya walk in this place it's like stepping back into the 1950's.  It's kinda awesome.  Definitely a small-town, homey feel that serves good ole family cookin'.  They had a iceskates up on the wall and a Christmas tree in the corner.  How precious.   
Don't come here expecting the best food in the whole wide world.  It is great for grandma's greasy cooking.  I've only eaten breakfast here but it's been amazing everytime.  I got pancakes and they are so fluffy and light and awesome (esp if you add a little butter).  The bacon was nice, thick, large slices; slightly overcooked maybe but super good cuz I love bacon! :)
The prices are reasonable and the service is great.  This is a great place for a quick delicious home cooked breakfast!
Help me polish this:
Don't be deceived by the exterior or your first impression when you step inside because the food here is truly excellent! As soon as you enter, it feels like you've traveled back to the charm of the 1950s, creating a delightful small-town ambiance. This cozy establishment offers comforting family-style cooking that will warm your heart. You'll even spot ice skates hanging on the walls and a cozy Christmas tree in the corner, adding to its precious appeal.

While it may not boast the absolute best cuisine in the world, it definitely excels at serving up delicious, wholesome dishes reminiscent of your grandmother's traditional cooking. Although I've only experienced their breakfast options, I must say that they have consistently exceeded my expectations. The pancakes are simply amazing – fluffy, light, and truly delightful, especially when topped with a bit of butter. The bacon deserves a special mention as well – it comes in thick, generous slices that may be slightly overcooked for some, but is undeniably delicious for bacon lovers like me!

In addition to the delectable food, the prices are reasonable and the service is exceptional. If you're looking for a satisfying, quick, and homemade breakfast, this establishment is the perfect choice for you.

input: Tried this place out after many suggestions from friends.  We went in one night about an hour or so before closing just to find that they were only serving a partial menu - we're not talking that late, it was like, 9:30 on a weekend.  There was no mention of going down to a bar menu on the website so I was a bit annoyed by that.  Something about 'surprise disappointments that could be totally avoided' really bother me.  So, the dish I had picked out online wasn't available and I ordered a burger instead.  The server seemed to have a very hard time understanding my burger and suggested that modifications couldn't be made?  I told him I'm sure removing a single topping wouldn't cause the kitchen staff any issues...  The rest of the meal we were generally ignored and the service wasn't great.  I found the food to be overpriced for the quality.  Unless there is a special reason to attend, I don't think we'll be going back.
Help me polish this:
After many recommendations from friends, we decided to give this place a try. Unfortunately, our experience was a bit disappointing. We arrived around 9:30 on a weekend, not particularly late, only to discover that they were only serving a partial menu. It was frustrating, especially since there was no prior mention of this on their website. These unexpected letdowns really bother me, as they could easily be avoided.

To make matters worse, the dish I had planned on ordering wasn't available, so I settled for a burger instead. However, the server had difficulty understanding my request for modifications. I simply wanted to remove a single topping, which I didn't think would be a problem for the kitchen staff. Despite explaining this, the server seemed unwilling to accommodate my request.

Throughout the rest of the meal, we felt ignored by the staff, and the overall service was lacking. Considering the quality of the food, we found it to be overpriced. Unless there is a special occasion or specific reason to return, I doubt we will be giving this place another chance.

input:
Second visit even better than the first!!  Loved the butternut squash and goat cheese Rangoons, and the delightfully filling mushroom yakisoba. Amazing flavor, and a smoky , meaty feel though it is meatless. Then came the coconut curry ramen. Heaven in a bowl. 
My only complaint is when you have to wait for seating there is no way to hang by the bar without constantly feeling you are in The servers' way as they breeze by with deliciousness in bowls and plates. So worth the wait before heading to the theater. Plus, food comes out very quickly so we made the curtain, just barely, but with really happy tummies.
Help me polish this:
Second visit surpassed our expectations and was even better than the first! We absolutely adored the butternut squash and goat cheese Rangoons, which had the perfect balance of flavors. The mushroom yakisoba was incredibly satisfying and had a delightful smoky essence, despite being meatless. And then, the coconut curry ramen... it was pure heaven in a bowl!

The only minor issue we had was during the wait for seating. It would be great if there was a designated area by the bar where patrons could comfortably hang out without feeling like they're in the way of the servers gracefully whisking by with mouthwatering dishes. However, the wait was definitely worth it, especially when you have a show to catch afterward. Plus, the food was promptly served, allowing us to make it to the theater just in the nick of time, all while having fully satisfied tummies.

input: I cannot comment on the food as I had only a couple beers. I did have the white IPA and a red ale which were good but not blow me away. I might be spoiled having 2 friends who brew professionally but the beers were good, not outstanding. The location is kind of far from other stuff which normally wouldn't bother me but everything around is seriously industrial and scenery does make a better place. They do discount the beer $1 when a train comes by and maybe that's the best they can make of a meh location. Probably give it more like a 3.5 stars. It does say something that there was a loyal following at 4pm on a Sunday.
Help me polish this:
I can't offer an opinion on the food since I only had a couple of beers. However, I did try their white IPA and red ale, both of which were enjoyable but didn't quite blow me away. It's possible that I've become accustomed to exceptional quality due to having two friends who brew professionally. While the beers were good, they didn't quite reach an outstanding level. 

In terms of location, it is somewhat remote, surrounded mainly by industrial areas. Typically, this wouldn't bother me, but having a more picturesque setting would enhance the overall experience. However, I do appreciate that they offer a $1 discount on beer when a train passes by, which is perhaps the best they can do considering the less-than-ideal location. This factor makes me inclined to give them a rating closer to 3.5 stars. Nonetheless, it is worth noting that even at 4pm on a Sunday, there was a devoted following present, which speaks volumes about the establishment.

input:
I first found out about this adorable little salon here on yelp while looking for a place to get a manicure downtown/ CBD.  I visited on 3/8/13 and got their "Mini Manicure"- it's only $15!  I chose an OPI polish and the nail technician did a GREAT job!  So great in fact, that today on Monday, 3/18/13- I did not have ONE CHIP!  This is amazing for polish!  My nails looked fabulous!  The technician was friendly, as were the other stylists.  I'm not sure if it was the manager or the owner that was working the front desk- but she came over as well and was super friendly and welcoming.  The salon looks amazing, trendy, and peaceful.  It has a great vibe.

I was so happy with my first appointment- that I went back today, and left disappointed.  I went to the same nail techinician- and we talked as she worked on my nails.  The person working the front desk (seemed like an owner/ manager- although different from my first visit) was SO  nice, welcoming, and talkative.  This time though I needed a gel manicure, in french- as I am in a wedding this weekend.  I explained that I was in the wedding, assuming the technician would know that this more special than just an everyday manicure  The technician stated after she started my nails, that she did not have the proper brush that she needed in order to do the manicure.  So like most places- they paint the white, and then go back later with a brush to create the crisp, perfect line.  Since she did not have the brush to do that- she used a q- tip.  So obviously the lines are not perfect or even.  Along with the lines being uneven- some are thicker than others, and the edges go up, instead of down.  My nails are not at all filed and shaped pretty either.  For $40 (+ a tip)- I really expect them to look right.  I went during my lunch hour, and it was supposed to be 30 minute appointment, but the appointment took a little bit over an hour.  I understand that french takes a little extra time- but this seemed like quite a bit extra.  I was late for work, and had to hurry out of there when she was finished and did not want to be even more late to work to stay there to make a complaint.  I wish I would have- but I also felt bad because the technician was trying so hard- but they are just not up to par.

I'm conflicted, but I don't know that I'll return.  I loved it to so much the first time, I even sent friends over there.  But after this time- I am not happy with the product.  I wish it wasn't gel- because I can't even take the polish off myself.  So I'm forced to have nails that I am unhappy with, or go to somewhere else and pay to have this taken off, and then pay to have them re done- all before a 6am flight on Wednesday morning, and it's Monday afternoon....
Help me polish this:
I initially discovered this charming salon through Yelp while searching for a downtown/CBD location to get a manicure. On 3/8/13, I visited the salon and opted for their "Mini Manicure" which is priced at an affordable $15. For my polish, I chose an OPI shade, and the nail technician did an outstanding job! To my surprise, not a single chip appeared on my nails even after a whole week. It was truly remarkable! My nails looked absolutely fabulous. The technician and the other stylists were friendly, and the person at the front desk, possibly the manager or owner, was also very welcoming. The salon itself had a trendy and peaceful atmosphere, creating a great overall experience.

Due to my positive first appointment, I decided to revisit the salon today. Unfortunately, I left feeling disappointed. I once again chose the same nail technician, and she worked on my nails while engaging in conversation. The individual at the front desk (presumably another owner or manager, different from my first visit) was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and talkative. However, this time I needed a gel manicure in a French style as I am attending a wedding this weekend. I expected the technician to understand the significance of this request, assuming it was more special than a regular manicure. However, she informed me after starting my nails that she did not possess the necessary brush required to achieve the desired French manicure look. Consequently, she resorted to using a q-tip instead. Naturally, this resulted in uneven lines that lacked the crisp perfection typically associated with French manicures. Some lines appeared thicker than others, and the edges of my nails protruded upward instead of being properly filed and shaped. Considering the expense of $40, not including the tip, I had anticipated a higher level of quality. Though French manicures require extra time, the appointment exceeded the expected duration of 30 minutes, causing me to be late for work. Unfortunately, I had to hastily leave the salon once she finished as I couldn't afford to be any later for work, preventing me from voicing my dissatisfaction. I regret not addressing this issue at that time, although I hesitated because the technician seemed to be putting in so much effort; however, the result did not meet my expectations.

I find myself conflicted, unsure if I will return to this salon. I adored it so much after my first visit that I even recommended it to my friends. Nevertheless, after this experience, I am genuinely dissatisfied with the outcome. I wish I had opted for a regular manicure instead of choosing gel because now I cannot remove the polish myself. I feel trapped either having to bear nails I am unhappy with or seeking another salon to have them properly redone - all before my 6 am flight on Wednesday morning. This inconvenience arises as it is currently Monday afternoon.

input:
A bit off the beaten path for most tourists, as it is in the Marigny, but worth the trip. Sure, the place is not perfect, but there are ultra-expensive restaurants in the FQ that are also not perfect. Look, cheap food, especially food this good, gives "wiggle" room for imperfections.

Breakfast served all day is a bonus. Sometimes you just got to have a lox omelet (under $10) late in the day. The restaurant boasts vegetarian and *gasp* vegan dishes, but someone needs to tell them that cheese doesn't fit into either of those categories. That aside, the french fry poboy, and the mac 'n cheese sandwiches are amazing. So is the Saturday Blue Plate of BBQ Chicken legs. 

Every entree is under $10, well except for the Friday Blue Plate, but why quibble? And who can argue with $5 Bloody Mary's, especially ones that are this good?
Help me polish this:
A hidden gem tucked away in the Marigny, this spot may not be on the typical tourist radar but is definitely worth a visit. While it may not offer the perfection found in high-end restaurants in the French Quarter, let's be real, even those pricey places have their flaws. Embrace the charm of imperfection, especially when it comes to affordable yet incredibly delicious dishes like the irresistible French fry poboy or the mouthwatering mac 'n cheese sandwiches.

One notable feature of this place is that breakfast is served all day, which is a major plus. Because let's face it, sometimes you just crave a lox omelet (and for under $10!) even late in the day. While the restaurant does offer vegetarian and vegan options, they might need a gentle reminder that cheese doesn't quite fit into either category. Nevertheless, their Saturday Blue Plate of BBQ Chicken legs is something you shouldn't miss.

The best part? Every single entree is priced under $10, with the exception of the Friday Blue Plate. But why quibble over a little detail like that when you can indulge in an incredible meal without breaking the bank? And as if that wasn't enough reason to visit, they also serve $5 Bloody Mary's that are truly exceptional. Trust us, you won't be disappointed.

input: Awesome sangria.  Rotating craft beers. Pizza and calzones keep me coming back
Help me polish this:
Experience the epitome of perfection with our incredible sangria, crafted to tantalize your taste buds and leave you craving more. Indulge in the refreshing combination of fruits and wine, expertly blended to create a flavor that is simply unrivaled.

If you're a beer connoisseur, prepare to be amazed by our ever-evolving selection of rotating craft beers. We take pride in curating a diverse array of brews, ensuring that each visit holds a new discovery for your palate. From crisp and hoppy IPAs to robust stouts and flavorful pale ales, our selection promises to satisfy even the most discerning beer enthusiasts.

But that's not all—we take our love for pizza and calzones to a whole new level. Feast on our mouthwatering creations crafted with the freshest ingredients, guaranteeing a deliciously perfect blend of flavors and textures. From classic margherita to adventurous gourmet combinations, each bite will transport you to pizza paradise. 

At our establishment, we understand that it takes something truly exceptional to keep you coming back, and that's why we pride ourselves on delivering an experience that goes above and beyond. So whether you're seeking a vibrant sangria, an enticing selection of craft beers, or delectable pizzas and calzones, our passion and dedication are sure to leave you wanting more. Indulge in the extraordinary, because you deserve nothing less.

input: First off, it is a bar through and through. The alcohol selection is good and the drinks well mixed. It is also a casino bar, so you'll be paying higher than average prices. There is a small food menu, but the selection isn't that great. To add insult to injury the food made me ill. The reviews about service aren't exaggerations. We, too, practically had to tackle our server to order food and drinks many of times. Not my preferred place to go when there are so many better options in Reno.
Help me polish this: First and foremost, this establishment undeniably embodies the essence of a bar. The range of alcoholic beverages available is commendable, and the cocktails are expertly crafted. However, being a casino bar, it is worth noting that prices here tend to be slightly higher than average. When it comes to dining options, regrettably, the menu is somewhat lacking in variety and quality. In fact, to make matters worse, the food served here actually made me unwell. The reviews regarding the level of service provided are not exaggerated; on numerous occasions, we found ourselves practically needing to chase down our server just to place orders for both food and drinks. With so many superior alternatives in Reno, this is certainly not my preferred choice of venue to visit.

input: Rude and unprofessional staff. I called today to find out if they had availability over the Thanksgiving holiday and the staff was short and basically said no then hung up the phone. I will take my business elsewhere.
Help me polish this: I had an unpleasant experience when contacting the establishment today regarding availability during the Thanksgiving holiday. Unfortunately, the staff I spoke with was rude and unprofessional in their response, abruptly informing me that there was no availability before abruptly ending the call. As a result, I have decided to explore other options for my needs.

input: Went there due to having a gc, and was suprised at the great food!  Had the sauteed stirfry over spinach, and my gf had the abundant pile of nachos.  They have a pretty decent selection of other delectables, and the day time bartender was very pleasant.  I would recommend to someone who wants a friendly atmosphere with decent food in a sports bar setting.  They actually do have sports playing on the tvs.
Help me polish this: I visited this place because I had a gift card, and to my surprise, the food was excellent! I ordered the sautéed stir-fry over spinach, while my girlfriend enjoyed a generous pile of nachos. Their menu also offers a decent variety of other delightful dishes, and the daytime bartender was exceptionally friendly. I would highly recommend this place to anyone who desires a welcoming atmosphere, good food, and a sports bar setting. Plus, they do have sports playing on the TVs!

input: Horrible experience, pizza was soggy and cold when I received it, took 2 hours until I actually received my order as well. Absolutely no communication on my order, even after calling twice. Once I finally received the pizza I called to get my money back, which was communicated that I would not be charged, soon to find out that I was charged the very next day. I highly recommend never ordering from here, service was horrible and they were extremely rude. I won't be ordering from here again and either should you.
Help me polish this:
My experience was extremely unpleasant. Not only was the pizza I received soggy and cold, but it also took a frustratingly long 2 hours for my order to arrive. Throughout this entire ordeal, there was a complete lack of communication regarding the status of my order, despite my efforts to contact them twice.

When the pizza finally arrived, I called immediately to request a refund, and I was assured that I would not be charged. To my disappointment, I discovered the following day that I had indeed been charged. This blatant disregard for their promise left me deeply dissatisfied.

I strongly urge everyone to refrain from ordering from this establishment. The service I received was abysmal, and the staff exhibited unacceptable rudeness. Based on my experience, I have made the decision to forgo any future orders from here, and I advise others to do the same.

input:
Incredible service and incredible food! The black bean ravioli is succulent! The bone-in steak was flavorful and amazingly juicy and delicious. And the best of all, service was perfect. From the friendly hostess to the waiter to the chef who personally came over to make sure we enjoyed our food, everyone really made us feel at home. 

As an added bonus, the ambiance is beautiful. Decor, lighting, and fireplace makes the place very homely. 

Highly recommended. I went as a group of four and had an excellent time.
Help me polish this:
I cannot recommend this place enough! The service we received was absolutely exceptional, and the food was beyond incredible. The black bean ravioli left us wanting more with its succulent flavor. The bone-in steak was undoubtedly the highlight of our meal - it was incredibly flavorful, juicy, and simply delicious.

What truly set this experience apart was the impeccable service from start to finish. From the moment we were greeted by the friendly hostess, to the attentive waiter, and even the chef who took the time to personally ensure our satisfaction, every staff member made us feel right at home.

To top it all off, the ambiance of the restaurant was stunning. The carefully thought out decor, well-placed lighting, and cozy fireplace created a warm and homely atmosphere that added to the overall dining experience.

We visited as a group of four, and it was truly an excellent time. If you're looking for a place with outstanding service, superb food, and a beautiful ambiance, I highly recommend giving this restaurant a try!

input:
I've been driving by this location for several weeks anticipating their opening.  With the established Legends Sports Bar directly across the street I thought this place must have something very special to feel they can compete.

They took over the building that was prevriously used by the Ruby River Steakhouse.  The owners apparently opted not to change a thing about the indoor seating.  Gone are all the cowboy boots, up are various team jerseys. It looks like somebody went to Pro Image at the mall to decorate the place.  Nothing appears to be autographed or evoke a sense of authenticity.

Video games are available for the kids, so bring your quarters.  No dart boards, shuffleboard, air hockey or pool tables.  This is pretty much a dine and drink only establishment.

More TV's in the place than I could count (I figure at least 20), all tuned to ESPN or ESPN2.  No clue at this time if they are choosing to use Direct TV, Dish, or Cable One for their service.  However, they already have made one of the biggest mistakes I think most wannabe sports bars make; they broadcast music rather than sound from a live sporting event.  With live sporting events available almost everyday from 12pm - 12am, you would think they would want to try to emphasize that rather than muzak (tuned to a country station; still feels like the Ruby River).

A word of advice here, if you want people to stay and eat and drink, you gotta give them something on which to focus their attention.  The sounds of the game will get their attention.  They came to a sports bar to think about sports, not Conway Twitty.

Typically, when I see the word pub in a restaurant name, I think it is just beer and wine, but it looks like Timeout has a full bar with several specialty drinks.  With a designated driver, it may be fun to experiment.

The food is typical sports bar fare; salads, burgers, pasta.  Most items will cost $9 - $11, with entrees running more.  A few twists on their offerings will ensure that I stop in to try something different, but unless the atmosphere improves, I think I will always leave a little disappointed. 

Those staying at the nearby motel may like the proximity, but I think they might find the walk across the street to Legends worth the extra steps.

Happy Hour 2pm - 6pm Monday -  Friday; Late Happy Hour 10pm - close Monday - Thursday.  Happy Hour all day Sunday.
Help me polish this:
I've been eagerly anticipating the opening of this location as I have driven by it for several weeks. Its close proximity to the established Legends Sports Bar across the street made me wonder what this place had to offer in order to compete.

It took over the building that was previously occupied by the Ruby River Steakhouse, but surprisingly, the new owners decided against making any changes to the indoor seating. The cowboy boots that once adorned the walls have been replaced by various team jerseys, giving the place a somewhat generic and mall-like appearance. None of the decorations seem to be autographed or evoke a sense of authenticity.

For those with kids, there are video games available, so don't forget your quarters. However, if you're looking for classic bar games like dart boards, shuffleboard, air hockey, or pool tables, you won't find them here. This establishment is mainly focused on dining and drinking.

There are an impressive number of TV's scattered throughout the place, easily over 20, all tuned to ESPN or ESPN2. It's unclear which TV service they are using, whether it's Direct TV, Dish, or Cable One. However, they've already made the mistake of playing music instead of broadcasting the sound from live sporting events. With sports being readily available almost every day from 12 pm to 12 am, it seems like a missed opportunity to not prioritize the sounds of the game instead of generic country music that still gives off a Ruby River vibe.

Here's a word of advice: if you want customers to stay, eat, and drink, you need to give them something to focus their attention on. The sound of the game is what will grab their attention. After all, people come to a sports bar to immerse themselves in sports, not to listen to country music like they're at a concert by Conway Twitty.

Typically, when I see the word "pub" in a restaurant name, I assume it only serves beer and wine. However, Timeout seems to have a full bar with several specialty drinks. It might be fun to try some of their unique offerings with a designated driver.

As for the food, it follows the typical sports bar fare: salads, burgers, and pasta. Most items are priced between $9 and $11, with the entrees being a bit pricier. They do have a few twists on their menu that caught my attention and make me want to stop by to try something different. However, unless the overall atmosphere improves, I suspect I'll always leave slightly disappointed.

If you're staying at the nearby motel, the proximity to Timeout might be convenient. However, I have a feeling that most people will find the short walk across the street to Legends worth the extra steps.

They offer happy hour from 2 pm to 6 pm Monday to Friday, with a late happy hour from 10 pm until close Monday to Thursday. On Sundays, enjoy happy hour all day long.

input: If you like onion rings order them here. Some of the best I have ever have. I also had a Reuben which was very good also.
Help me polish this: If you're a fan of onion rings, make sure to order them here - they're truly some of the best I've ever had. In addition, I tried their Reuben sandwich and it was also very delicious.

input: The cutest and definitely the friendliest coffee shop in Boise! The coffee is great but the staff is even better. Love this place!
Help me polish this: Discover the epitome of charm and warmth at the most endearing coffee shop in Boise! With its delightful ambiance and exceptional coffee, this place stands out. However, what truly sets it apart is the staff's incredible friendliness and genuine hospitality. You cannot help but feel embraced by their warm smiles and attentive service. This coffee shop has certainly captured a special place in my heart - I absolutely adore it!

input:
Hubby and I were eager to try this establishment due to a rave review from some close friends. We decided for our date night we would give it a try on Saturday. We pulled up about 8pm and the open sign was turned off. We thought maybe the light was burnt out or someone just forgot to plug it in. So we proceeded to the door. There were people inside and the sign said open till 11pm, so we walked inside. It was like walking into the Twlight Zone, everyone stopped and stared at us. The woman behind the bar came over and told us they were closed. HUH! Ok.... so we left. It was very akward and unpleasant. If they were closed then the door should of been locked or a sign on the door stating private party or something. 
Not sure if we will attempt to try to dine there again.
Help me polish this: My husband and I were excited to try out this establishment based on a glowing recommendation from some close friends. So, for our date night, we decided to give it a shot on a Saturday. Arriving at around 8pm, we noticed that the open sign was turned off. We initially dismissed it, thinking that maybe the light was burnt out or someone had forgotten to plug it in. With the sight of people inside and a sign indicating that they were open until 11pm, we confidently walked in. However, the moment we stepped inside, it felt as though we had entered the Twilight Zone. Everyone stopped and stared at us. It was incredibly uncomfortable and awkward. Eventually, a woman behind the bar approached us and bluntly informed us that they were closed. Confused and taken aback, we left. It would have been much better if the door had been locked or if there was a sign stating that they were hosting a private party. Given this experience, we're unsure if we'll make another attempt to dine there.

input: Awesome food! It was so fresh and delicious. The papaya salad was delicious! Try the curry..simply spicy and beautiful. The service was great too! They have take out!!!
Help me polish this: Incredible food! Everything was incredibly fresh and absolutely delicious. The papaya salad in particular was truly outstanding. You must try their curry - it's irresistibly spicy and beautifully presented. Additionally, the service was outstanding, and they even offer takeout for added convenience!

input: I have new dental insurance and had to find a dentist in network and came across Music City Dental. Dr. Spurlin and her staff are great! They are very gentle and make sure the patient is comfortable at all times. I had to get a filling and am terrified of shots. I didn't even feel when Dr. Spurlin gave me my shot. I was offered a pillow, blanket and choice of watching a movie or listening to music. I had a pleasant experience and am definitely a permanent patient!
Help me polish this: I recently acquired new dental insurance and had the task of finding a dentist who is in network. Luckily, I discovered Music City Dental and had an exceptional experience there. Dr. Spurlin and her staff are truly amazing! They take great care to ensure the patient's comfort at all times, displaying a gentle touch throughout the entire process. Despite my fear of shots, I was pleasantly surprised when I didn't feel a thing when Dr. Spurlin administered the shot for my filling. Moreover, I was provided with a pillow, blanket, and the option to watch a movie or listen to music, which made the experience even more enjoyable. Thanks to the outstanding service I received, I am now a permanent patient of Music City Dental!

input:
The beef noodles was a bit too salty and the fried rice was a bit oily. But overall they are good. We liked the shrimp spring rolls a lot. It is one of the best we have tried. 

The place could have earned higher points. But I have to give it a three stars because of the chaotic seating arrangement. The owner gave tables to people behind us despite we reminded the him and the staff. Perhaps that is what you get when you go to a teeny tiny Chinese restaurant during a long weekend.
Help me polish this:
The beef noodles were slightly over-seasoned and the fried rice was a touch greasy. However, overall, they were still enjoyable. The highlight for us was definitely the shrimp spring rolls, which were some of the best we've ever had.

Although the place had the potential for a higher rating, we can only give it three stars due to the disorderly seating arrangement. Despite reminding the owner and staff, they seated people who arrived after us before us. Perhaps this is to be expected when visiting a small Chinese restaurant during a busy long weekend.

input:
Great community vibe... i've run into friends and struck up conversation with new ones each time i've been in.  Its nice to have new hang within walking distance of my house.  I've stuck to the classic burger and love it... everything from the buns to the ketchup is made in-house and has unique taste. The bar had pretty much whatever i wanted... last night the bartenders made some homespun watermelon concoction.

To touch on some other reviews... i understand everyone has a different experience, but to say the place is 'too hipster' seems like someones still jaded from feeling left out in high school...  and personally attacking the owner is tasteless and has no place in a review.  We should be glad we don't all have someone looking over our shoulder attacking our motives. I like what Burger Up is trying to do and i like that they hired a bunch of folks representative of our Nashville community... if you need a non-musician wait staff who dresses just like you and takes you to prom, you're probably in the wrong town.
Help me polish this:
Great community vibe... I've consistently encountered friends and struck up conversations with new people each time I've visited. It's truly a pleasure having a new hangout spot within walking distance of my house. As for the food, I've stuck to the classic burger and it never fails to impress. From the homemade buns to the unique taste of their in-house ketchup, every component is crafted with care. The bar is also well-stocked, always offering a wide range of options. Just last night, the bartenders impressed me with their homemade watermelon concoction.

Addressing some of the other reviews, I understand that everyone has their own experience, but labeling the place as "too hipster" seems reminiscent of someone still holding onto past high school experiences. Furthermore, personally attacking the owner reflects poor taste and has no place in a proper review. We should be appreciative that we are not constantly scrutinized in the same manner, with someone attacking our every motive. I appreciate what Burger Up is trying to accomplish and the fact that they have created a diverse staff representative of our vibrant Nashville community. If you're seeking a wait staff devoid of musicians, dressed in a manner similar to your own, and accompanying you to prom, then perhaps this town is not the most suitable for your expectations.

input: I am not an indian food type of person but this place lives up to the hype. When you go, just let Hassan make something for you, don't try and overwhelm yourself with the different options. Make sure to get a chaat and a lassi as the two really complement one another.
Help me polish this: I usually don't gravitate towards Indian cuisine, but this place truly lives up to its hype. If you happen to visit, I highly recommend putting your trust in Hassan's hands and allowing him to prepare something for you. It can be overwhelming to choose from a wide range of options, so it's better to let the expert decide. Don't miss out on trying their delightful chaat alongside a refreshing lassi, as they perfectly complement each other.

input:
Excellent food, good service, great location. 

My wife had shrimp and grits, I had the barbecued shrimp -- both were outstanding. The appetizers were good. The bread pudding was a tad dry in the city that is supposed to be the mother lode of bread pudding. 

Mr. B came close to snagging the fifth star but the service could have been more attentive and the place is freezing - - in July in New Orleans. Wear long sleeves or bring a jacket.
Help me polish this:
Experience exceptional food, accompanied by delightful service, in an idyllic location. My wife savored the delectable shrimp and grits, while I indulged in the heavenly barbecued shrimp - both dishes were beyond compare. The appetizers provided a satisfactory start to our meal. However, I must admit that the bread pudding, although expected to be exquisite in the city renowned for it, fell slightly short with a touch of dryness.

Despite its near-perfection, Mr. B narrowly missed obtaining a fifth star due to the lack of attentiveness from the staff and uncomfortably cold interior - an unexpected chill, even for the typically warm New Orleans climate in the month of July. It is advisable to come prepared with long sleeves or a jacket to ensure comfort during your visit.

input:
Wow. We visited NOLA last week and took the truly awesome and informative  Steamboat Natchez trip on March 30. Can't tell you how interesting it was and pleasant. Plus these people are so well-organized and nice. JoJo reserved us a window seat - just could not believe the kind and excellent service. 
Very very nice.  Recommend!!!!
Help me polish this: Wow! We had the most incredible experience in NOLA last week when we embarked on the truly awe-inspiring Steamboat Natchez trip on March 30. Words simply can't express how captivating and pleasant it was. The level of organization and hospitality exhibited by the staff was exceptional. JoJo, in particular, went above and beyond to secure us a window seat, which truly astounded us with their kindness and excellent service. This experience was nothing short of amazing, and we highly recommend it to anyone visiting NOLA.

input: Quite possibly the perfect business model to fail if it wasn't for a sequestered clientel?  We visit New Orleans often, and it is an activity of ours to bet on how many beers or ingredients they are out of.  Bartenders rude and swearing. It's almost comical, we sit and listen to patrons asking for draft beers and mixed drinks and getting responses "can't do that".  They said "No mules", to at least 5 people as we sat for about 30 mins today.  2 out of 4 taps not working. What an absolute waste of opportunity.
Help me polish this: Probably one of the most intriguing business models destined for failure if it weren't for a secluded client base. During our frequent visits to New Orleans, my companions and I have made it a sport to guess just how many beers or ingredients will be unavailable at this establishment. The bartenders themselves, known for their brash demeanor and colorful language, almost provide a sense of entertainment. It's become somewhat comical for us to witness patrons excitedly ordering draft beers or mixed drinks, only to be met with a disappointing "can't do that." Today alone, we counted at least five people who were denied the pleasure of enjoying a classic Moscow Mule. Not to mention, two out of the four taps weren't even operational. It truly is disheartening to witness such a tremendous waste of potential.

input: We had a mixed experience at Mr. B's.  We started at the bar for drinks and a starter due to table wait. Bar was nice for a busy night. Our table was ready early so the bar staff transferred our starter to the table and things went down hill quickly. Starters were delivered and then we were ignored for over 45 minutes. No drinks, water etc. Finally a waiter in another section took out order. We ordered BBQ shrimp (best thing on our table), rabbit and wood plank grilled fish. Fish was a very small piece and not worth the $$$. Rabbit was good! Hit and miss service ruined the experience.
Help me polish this: We had a somewhat inconsistent experience at Mr. B's. Initially, we had to wait for a table and decided to enjoy some drinks and a starter at the bar. Despite the bustling atmosphere, the bar was quite pleasant. However, once our table became available, things took a turn for the worse. Although the bar staff kindly transferred our starter to our table, the service quickly deteriorated. After the starters were delivered, we found ourselves neglected for over 45 minutes without any sign of our drinks or water. Eventually, a waiter from another section took our order. Among the dishes we ordered were the BBQ shrimp, which turned out to be the highlight of our meal, and the rabbit, which was quite satisfying. However, the wood plank grilled fish was disappointingly small and overpriced. Unfortunately, the inconsistent service ultimately tarnished our overall experience at the restaurant.

input:
This place is so cute. The interior is adorable and casual. There's some small booths and chairs and tables for hanging out and enjoying your food/drinks. It's all so clean, too, which is a huge plus.
There's a little section with baked goods, some Asian and some more American. They have mostly Vietnamese food, but I also saw some other types of food (e.g bulgogi).
I came in with two friends and the woman who helped us was really personable and friendly. We ordered banh mi and boba tea, and sat down waiting for our food to be brought to us. The banh mi was really yummy, especially the bread. I had boba milk tea, which was as good as any milk tea I've had before. 
They have a drink card which you can get stamped to receive a free tenth drink. Definitely an incentive to return. Also, their hours are awesome, which is a huge plus.
Help me polish this:
This place is absolutely adorable. The interior design is charming and has a casual vibe. There are small booths, chairs, and tables where you can relax and enjoy your food or drinks. What impressed me the most is how clean everything is, which is definitely a huge plus.

They have a delightful section dedicated to baked goods, with a mix of both Asian and American options. Although they mainly serve Vietnamese food, I was pleased to see that they also had other types of cuisine, such as bulgogi.

When I visited with two friends, we were warmly greeted by a personable and friendly woman who assisted us. We ordered banh mi sandwiches and boba tea, then took a seat while waiting for our food to be served. The banh mi was incredibly tasty, especially the bread. I also had the pleasure of indulging in a boba milk tea, which was on par with some of the best milk teas I've had before.

An additional perk is their drink card program, where you can collect stamps to earn a free drink after every tenth purchase. This definitely enhances the desire to return. Furthermore, their convenient hours of operation are another big advantage.

input: I stopped at Walgreens in hopes of seeing the new ELF Villain's collection. Sometimes Walgreens gets them before the holidays. Sometimes they don't. This particular one doesn't ever get them according to their cosmetics person. SAD. Really sad. I suppose I'll have to skulk other Walgreens to find them.
Help me polish this: I made a quick stop at Walgreens today, excitedly hoping to catch a glimpse of the new ELF Villain's collection. As some Walgreens tend to release them ahead of the holidays, I had my fingers crossed. However, to my dismay, it turns out that this specific location never receives these collections, as confirmed by their cosmetics representative. Quite disappointing, to say the least. Now it seems I'll have to embark on a mission to scout out other Walgreens to get my hands on them.

input: This is the best Italian food I've ever had. Very small elegant restaurant, entrees were really good and very tasty cheesecake. To top it off, the entire staff was super friendly. Highly recommended for date night.
Help me polish this:
I couldn't recommend this place more for a delightful date night experience. From the moment we walked into this small and elegant restaurant, I knew we were in for a treat. The food surpassed all expectations - hands down the best Italian cuisine I have ever had. The entrees were bursting with flavors that were simply unforgettable. And let's not forget about the incredible cheesecake, which was incredibly tasty and the perfect ending to our meal.

But it wasn't just the food that impressed me. The attentive and friendly staff truly made our experience memorable. From their welcoming smiles to their genuine eagerness to assist, they went above and beyond to ensure our evening was nothing short of perfection.

If you're looking for an extraordinary dining experience to impress your significant other, this place is an absolute must-visit. Its intimate ambiance, impeccable food, and exceptional service make it the ideal spot for a romantic and unforgettable date night.

input:
This is my favourite place to get fish tacos! It's all I ever order, along with the occasional queso or beans which are also delicious. My friend was visiting from out of town and he ordered the beef taco and chicken fajitas and thought they were pretty average. However, he agreed that the fish tacos were amazing. Since 2 full me up and they're only like $2.60 each it's a pretty happy visit all round for me! Plus the interior and patio are awesome
(And there's Ben and Jerry's right next door for dessert)
Help me polish this:
This is definitely my go-to spot for the most delicious fish tacos! Every time I dine here, I can't help but order my all-time favorite - the fish tacos. They never disappoint! Occasionally, I'll add a side of queso or beans, which are also incredibly tasty. 

While my friend was visiting from out of town, they decided to try the beef taco and chicken fajitas. Unfortunately, they found them to be just average. However, we both agreed that the fish tacos were outstanding. 

What I love even more is that two fish tacos are enough to satisfy my appetite, and at just $2.60 each, it's an excellent value. Overall, every visit to this place leaves me feeling incredibly content. The ambiance of both the interior and patio is awesome, adding to the overall dining experience. And to top it off, there's a Ben and Jerry's right next door for dessert!

input:
Stopped here last week while in the area from Burbank. Had read about it on Trip Advisor. It is in a great location, quiet, peaceful and cool under the shade of the big old trees. For its location and it being noon on a Thursday we were surprised to find there was literally only one table open when we walked in. Food is served pretty quick though so it didn't seem anyone was really waiting. 
Based on reviews we had read, my hubby had the tri-tip sandwich. I ordered the buffalo burger. I have to say that was one of the best burgers I have ever had in my life. As usual, we traded tastes of our orders. My hubby was so jealous of my buffalo burger and I heard about it several more times throughout the day, that he should've got the burger. The tri-tip was quite dry, and it was literally just the meat on bread, big bread.  The horseradish sauce (served on the side) was very tasty though.
For the tri-tip, I give a 3, hubby gives a 4. We both give the buffalo burger a definite 5++.

Either way, worth checking out if you want something with a unique atmosphere and that is away from town but not a long drive. Very peaceful.
Help me polish this:
During our visit to Burbank, we decided to stop by this restaurant after reading positive reviews on Trip Advisor. The restaurant's location is truly remarkable - nestled amidst tranquil surroundings, shaded by magnificent old trees. Since it was a Thursday afternoon, we were surprised to find only one table available upon our arrival. However, the service was prompt, and it didn't seem like anyone was waiting for their food.

Based on the recommendations we had seen, my husband opted for the tri-tip sandwich, while I decided to try the buffalo burger. Let me tell you, the buffalo burger was hands down one of the best burgers I have ever tasted in my life. As always, we shared bites of our meals, and my husband couldn't help but express his envy towards my burger. In fact, he mentioned it numerous times throughout the day, regretting not ordering it himself. On the other hand, the tri-tip sandwich was a bit disappointing as it lacked moisture and was essentially just meat served on oversized bread. The saving grace was the flavorsome horseradish sauce served on the side.

In terms of ratings, I would give the tri-tip a 3, while my husband leans towards a 4. However, we both unequivocally agree on giving the buffalo burger a resounding 5++.

Regardless of our varying experiences, this restaurant is certainly worth a visit if you're seeking a distinctive atmosphere away from the hustle and bustle of town without having to endure a lengthy drive. The tranquility it offers is simply unparalleled.

input:
I have frequented the Mad Mex, University City location for years.  I was pleased to see this new location which is closer to my home and I don't have to deal with the obnoxious students.  I have been here for Happy Hour and just for dinner at another time.  It has been busy both times and it seems that the staff need to be trained a little more in chaos and crowd management.  The best deals are during Happy Hour - the $3, $5 & $7 Margarita's.  I also believe wings are 1/2 off.  My friends seemed to enjoy their orders of Burritos, Gaucamole and enchiladas.  

The food is average and for the price of drinks - it would be a great place to hang if the service improves.

input:
I brought my boyfriend here on a Saturday for a tour and beer sampling since Yuengling is one of his favorite beers. We never knew it was so close!

Be sure to look on their website for tour times before going and read the FAQ's. 
- First note: There were many people wearing flip flops on our tours vs. the insisted closed toe shoe policy, but that could be because of the next note.
- Second note: There is no production/brewing on Saturdays so the brewery is quiet and empty.

We looked around the main waiting/lobby area and gift shop waiting for our 12p tour to begin.  We had quite a large group, which had to split into two smaller ones. The tour lasted about 40 minutes, starting with a ten minute video of the history of Yuengling and the rise to present day. Next, the guide takes you out to the brewery, and into the kettle room, around through the lab, the bottle line, and the holding tanks. The tour was informative and hands on. Our guide was informative and knew quite a lot about the history and brewing process. She did a great job!

Once done, you loop back into the lobby where the tasting room is and it's drinks galore. The BEST PART? FREE. Tips are encouraged! ;)
We tried the Premium Lager, Lager, and Black and Tan. Sadly they were out of the Lord Chesterfield this day and the Premium Light is not available here in FL.

Overall, a great tour and I will be revisitng with my parents when they are in town!

Overall, it was a fantastic tour experience, and I can't wait to visit again with my parents when they come to town!

input:
Really disappointed. I've been to the Marathon at 18/Spruce and had excellent service, drinks and food. Thought that would transfer to this location - not at all.

To sum it up, our server was extremely energetic, but not in a good way. More like a frantic energy. I was there to enjoy a few drinks and dinner with a friend who was visiting (AKA looking to spend money AKA you will get a larger tip if you let us stay longer) and we were rushed out. Server brought boxes for food we were still eating, without asking if we wanted them. A few minutes later he physically put the food in the boxes at the tableside while mumbling something like "I don't like food sitting on the table." .....we didn't even want to take it home. Next, when we said we were having another friend join for another round or two of drinks he told us we couldn't stay at the booth we were at and we needed to go to the bar. What? I point blank asked him if he was kicking us out of the booth and he said "yes!" energetically. There was no one waiting for tables and there were numerous open tables/booths around the restaurant. I felt extremely uncomfortable and wanted to leave immediately. Our friend joined after all this happened, and when the server came over to ask if they wanted a drink, he seemed surprised when we told him we were just going to leave. YOU LITERALLY just told us we couldn't sit at this table any longer!! We then left.

I worked in restaurants for a long time and I'm pretty easy to please when it comes to restaurant service. I was not pleased at all during this visit.

On another note, the food was not that great.
Help me polish this:

My friend and I were simply looking to relax and enjoy our drinks and dinner, as my friend was visiting and we were willing to spend money, potentially resulting in a larger tip. Unfortunately, we were instead hurried out of the restaurant. The server brought boxes for the food we were still eating without even asking if we wanted them. Within minutes, he began putting our food in the boxes right in front of us, muttering something about not wanting food to sit on the table. I directly asked him if he was kicking us out of the booth, to which he energetically responded, "yes!" This made me feel extremely uncomfortable, and I immediately wanted to leave. Once our friend arrived, the server seemed surprised when we informed him that we were actually leaving. How could he not recall that he had just prohibited us from sitting there? It was a highly frustrating experience.

Having worked in the restaurant industry for an extended period of time, I am typically quite easy to please when it comes to service. However, this visit left me thoroughly dissatisfied.

In addition to the disappointing service, the quality of the food was underwhelming.

input: We arrived for lunch at 12p on a Friday - wasn't busy at all. It took FOREVER to get anything.
