input: This was such a nice change from the other restaurants. Simple fresh organic food.  Full coffee, latte, etc options. Sasquatch brew is delicious. Also, very nice ambiance. Casual, relaxed, and comfortable. The owners are amazing and friendly.
Help me polish this: This dining experience was truly a refreshing departure from other restaurants. The simple yet satisfying menu consisted of fresh, organic food that left a delightful taste in my mouth. Moreover, the wide selection of coffee options, including lattes and more, ensured a full and satisfying experience. Without a doubt, the Sasquatch brew was an absolute delight. Additionally, the ambiance of the restaurant was exceptionally pleasant, promoting a casual, relaxed, and comfortable environment. What truly made this place special was the exceptional hospitality of the owners, who were not only amazing but also incredibly friendly.

input: Delicious! Best place around for ice cream . Everything is made fresh from cows without hormones and antibiotics . It's cash only, but it's worth the trip to the ATM.
Help me polish this: Delicious! Indulge in the ultimate ice cream experience at the best place around. All our delectable flavors are carefully crafted from fresh milk sourced exclusively from hormone and antibiotic-free cows. Though we operate on a cash-only basis, don't let that deter you - the journey to the nearest ATM is well worth the exceptional treats that await you.

input:
This was our second choice after finding out Rio Mar was closed for Mardi Gras week. We had a hell of a time getting here since it was on the other side of the parade from where we were staying.
   Nonetheless, we had a great meal. 
    Service was spot on. Professional but not overbearing or obvious. 
    A little disappointed that they were out of two ingredients for one of their signature cocktails, but it WAS the day before Mardi Gras.
   The bread and butter at the table was excellent. Crunchy outside, soft inside.
   The beets salad was so much better and different from similarly named items at other restaurants. The greens literally tasted like they had been picked from a sun warmed field minutes before.
    G's Choucroute was a meaty fiesta. He loved it. My crab ravioli was lovely with a delicate Meyer lemon sauce. 
    Bread pudding for dessert was just how we like it - sans raisins.
    Truly a memorable meal. Way better than most hotel restaurants.
Help me polish this:
This became our second option after discovering that Rio Mar was closed for Mardi Gras week. Despite the difficulty of reaching the place due to its location on the opposite side of the parade from where we were staying, we eventually made it and had a fantastic time.

The service was excellent, striking the perfect balance between professionalism and attentiveness without being overwhelming. However, we were slightly disappointed to learn that they had run out of two ingredients for one of their signature cocktails. Nevertheless, considering it was the day before Mardi Gras, it was somewhat expected.

The bread and butter served at our table were truly exceptional, with a crisp outer crust and soft, fluffy interior. The beet salad exceeded our expectations and was unlike anything we had tried before at other restaurants. The flavors were bright and fresh, as if the greens had been plucked from a sun-warmed field just moments prior.

G's Choucroute dish was a flavorful feast comprised of various meats, and he thoroughly enjoyed it. My crab ravioli, accompanied by a delicate Meyer lemon sauce, was delightful. For dessert, the bread pudding was exactly how we prefer it - without raisins.

Overall, this dining experience was truly memorable, surpassing the average expectations typically associated with hotel restaurants.

input: Found 51st Deli on Uber Eats and we loved it!!! I can't wait to check it out in person!
Help me polish this: Discovered 51st Deli on Uber Eats and we absolutely loved it! Now, I'm eagerly looking forward to experiencing it in person!

input: The Honey Apple grilled cheese sandwich is totally to die for! I never been more happy to eat a grilled cheese sandwich in my life! The staff is friendly, the decor is cool and hip, and the food is great. The Meltdown in Montgomeryville does not compare. The service is rude and the decor is too futuristic/weird. I had my server throw my sandwich at me and splash another customer with soup at Montgomeryville. Regardless of then other shops, I love meltdown it really helps a cheese lover out!
Help me polish this:
The Honey Apple grilled cheese sandwich at Meltdown is absolutely exceptional! It has made me the happiest I've ever been when eating a grilled cheese sandwich. The staff is incredibly friendly, and the decor has a cool and hip vibe that adds to the overall experience. The food itself is truly amazing.

On the other hand, I cannot say the same for The Meltdown in Montgomeryville. It simply doesn't compare. The service is consistently rude, and the decor is too futuristic and weird for my taste. To make matters worse, during my visit, my server actually threw my sandwich at me and even splashed another customer with soup. This kind of behavior is completely unacceptable.

Despite the subpar experience at other shops, Meltdown remains my absolute favorite. It caters perfectly to cheese lovers like myself and never fails to deliver an extraordinary grilled cheese sandwich.

input:
They have combination deals that make rolls and sushi super cheap! The rolls are definitely on the smaller side, so you'll need to order up on the combination deal if you want to get full. Sashimi was actually more fresh than I thought it would be, considering the price! 

Also, the joint is sort of small, and the service is slow, but the place is BYO, so you can just head downstairs and bring up some beers while you're waiting.

input: The food was good, service was horrible. I ordered orange juice for my kids and waited till we were almost done eating then finally got the juices. They take cash or checks only. Everything else was OK, but they could do a little bit better on their service.
Help me polish this: The food was delicious, but unfortunately, the service left much to be desired. I requested orange juice for my children upon arrival, but it wasn't brought to our table until we were nearly finished with our meal. Additionally, the restaurant only accepts payment in cash or checks, which is a slight inconvenience. While everything else was satisfactory, there is certainly room for improvement when it comes to their service.

input:
After coming here for many years, I was very disappointed by my last trip. The one place you never cut corners is in the food, and that's exactly what they did. 2 of the 3 salsas were so watery that you didn't get any tomatillo or tomato on your chip, at all. The third salsa, the pics de gallo, was the worst chop job I've ever seen in a restaurant. Huge pieces of Serrano pepper with varying sizes of everything else, and in stark contrast to the other 2, completely dried out. 

Without even looking at the menu, I know what I want... #15. That decision hasn't changed for over 10 years. Today I should have made a different choice. I'm not sure if they recently went thru a purveyor change but the quality of everything on the plate was horrible. 

I used to love the rice, it changed. I used to love the chicken quesadilla, now it's flavorless and covered in 2 lbs of cheese for 1/2 a breast.

Please go back to your old ways and cut costs elsewhere, other than the food.
Help me polish this:
After being a loyal customer for many years, my last trip to this place left me deeply disappointed. It is widely known that one should never compromise on the quality of food, yet that's exactly what they did. Out of the three salsas they served, two were incredibly watery, lacking any trace of tomatillo or tomato on the chip. As for the third salsa, the pico de gallo, it was the worst preparation I have ever witnessed in a restaurant. The Serrano peppers were improperly chopped, leaving huge pieces that overshadowed everything else. To make matters worse, this salsa was completely dried out, in stark contrast to the other two.

Even without looking at the menu, I have always known what I want: #15. This decision hasn't changed in over 10 years. However, today I should have opted for something different. I can't say for certain whether they recently changed suppliers, but the quality of every item on the plate was absolutely dreadful.

I used to adore their rice, but it has lost its former appeal. The chicken quesadilla, once bursting with flavor, has now become tasteless and drowned in an excessive amount of cheese that overshadows a measly half-breast serving.

I implore them to return to their old ways and find ways to cut costs without sacrificing the quality of their food.

input: Just got 2 tattoos at Stigma today and I am so happy! I went there because they have good reviews and their website is good. I got a cluster or roses on my shoulder with some "brush strokes" of color on them. My tattoo artist is Eddie. He is very friendly and fun! He did exactly like I asked. He is a very good artist. His line work is perfect and so I will be going back to him for more. I have a bad back (bulging and hemorrhaged discs) and sometimes I can't sit in the same place for long periods of time. Eddie was very helpful and accommodating with that. While I was there I talked to pretty much every employee there. The entire staff are really friendly. It's a cool place to be. I did a Yelp check-in and got $10 off! How cool is that?! On the website I saw that the owner, Chino developed his own tattoo ointment. He said that he just wasn't very happy with the other stuff that's out there because they are petroleum product so he did a ton of research and developed his own. It has ingredients like sunflower and soybean oil, lavender, beeswax, vitamin E, Shea and cocoa butter. I bought some and it is indeed very soothing. If you are looking to get inked, go here. You will be in good hands with some great artists and you will be just as happy as I am right now.
Help me polish this:
I recently had an amazing experience at Stigma, where I got two tattoos today, and I can't express how happy I am! I chose Stigma based on their outstanding reviews and their impressive website. For my shoulder, I opted for a stunning cluster of roses with "brush strokes" of color, expertly done by tattoo artist Eddie. Eddie is not only friendly and fun, but he also nailed exactly what I had envisioned. I couldn't be more impressed with his exceptional artistic skills and flawless line work. Naturally, I'll be returning to him for future tattoos.

One concern I had was my bad back, as I suffer from bulging and hemorrhaged discs that make it difficult to sit for extended periods of time. However, Eddie was incredibly understanding and accommodating throughout the process, which I truly appreciated. In fact, I had the opportunity to chat with all the employees at Stigma, and they are all incredibly friendly. The overall atmosphere of the studio is vibrant and welcoming, making it a cool place to spend time in.

To make things even better, I received a $10 discount for checking in on Yelp, which was an unexpected bonus. While browsing their website, I discovered that the owner, Chino, developed his own tattoo ointment. This intrigued me because Chino mentioned that he wasn't satisfied with other petroleum-based products in the market. After conducting extensive research, he created his own formula, which includes natural ingredients like sunflower and soybean oil, lavender, beeswax, vitamin E, Shea, and cocoa butter. Intrigued by its promises, I purchased the ointment and found it to be incredibly soothing.

If you're considering getting a tattoo, I highly recommend choosing Stigma. You'll be in the hands of talented artists, including Eddie, who will bring your vision to life. Trust me, you'll be just as ecstatic as I am right now!

input: This place is a lot of fun. I like that there is a outdoor patio with hip hop music and indoor dance area with salsa . If you need a change in tunes or scenery , just move !
Help me polish this: This place is absolutely fantastic! I love how it offers diverse entertainment options, with an outdoor patio playing hip hop music and an indoor dance area where you can groove to salsa beats. The best part is, if you're looking for a change in music or scenery, all you have to do is simply move around!

input:
Had not been for years.

We went for lunch. Great decor. Great wait staff. Personable and on the ball.

My bud had the fish special, serving was a bit small but delish he said.

I had the fattoush salad with chicken. Spicing was everything it should be. The chicken was good, just that. The lettuce was limp and so was the pita. Not an olive in sight.

Pricey, especially for lunch. We will not be rushing back.
Help me polish this:
If not for the fact that it had been years, we went out for lunch. The restaurant had a great decor and the wait staff was impressive - personable and attentive.

My friend ordered the fish special, which he found to be delicious despite the small portion.

As for me, I opted for the fattoush salad with chicken. The seasoning was on point, and the chicken was good, though nothing extraordinary. However, the lettuce and pita were both limp and there were no olives to be found.

Unfortunately, the price was quite high, especially considering that it was just for lunch. All in all, we do not plan on making a hasty return.

input: Our animals are an extension of our family.  So, we aren't going to take them to any old place for boarding, grooming and medical examinations.  I'm a big fan of the Animal Clinic because they treat the pets as if they were their own pets.  You can't ask for any more.  I would have given them 5* but the location is a little difficult to get out of when leaving.
Help me polish this: Our animals are not just pets but cherished members of our family. Therefore, when it comes to boarding, grooming, and medical examinations, we refuse to settle for anything less than the best. I can personally vouch for the Animal Clinic as they go above and beyond in treating our pets with the same love and care as if they were their own. It's hard to ask for anything more from such exceptional service. While I would have rated them 5 stars, it's worth mentioning that the location can be a bit challenging to navigate when leaving.

input: Literally, the worst Taco Bell I have ever been to. The restaurant is filthy, the service is awful, and they didn't make any of our order correctly, and really, how hard is that?  I won't be back and if I were you I would find a different place to go.
Help me polish this: I had an incredibly disappointing experience at Taco Bell, easily ranking it as the worst one I've ever visited. The restaurant's cleanliness was severely lacking, the service left much to be desired, and to top it off, none of our orders were prepared correctly. Honestly, it's hard to comprehend how they managed to get simple orders wrong. Needless to say, I won't be returning anytime soon, and I highly recommend seeking alternatives should you consider dining there.

input:
I like the Neuvo-Latino-Americano grub here.  The place has moved locations and is now a bit larger.  Chips & Salsa are always fresh 7 tasty, too.

I wish I could give a more substanital review but I ate here so long ago - and at the old location - so I'd better just keep my mouth shut.
Help me polish this:
I thoroughly enjoy the delicious Neuvo-Latino-American cuisine offered at this establishment. Notably, the restaurant has relocated and now boasts a more spacious setting. Additionally, their Chips & Salsa are consistently fresh and flavorful.

Unfortunately, due to the long gap since my last visit and the change in location, I am unable to provide a comprehensive review. Therefore, I believe it would be best for me to refrain from offering any further commentary.

input: Found Player's while driving by. Everyone is very friendly. The service is great. Atmosphere is very relaxed. Great experience overall. Oh and a great shave and cut for a great price!
Help me polish this: I recently stumbled upon Player's while driving by, and I couldn't be more pleased with my experience. From the moment I stepped in, everyone was incredibly friendly and accommodating. The service provided was top-notch, and the atmosphere within the salon was wonderfully relaxed. Overall, my visit to Player's was a truly fantastic experience. I also received an excellent shave and haircut, all at an incredibly reasonable price. I highly recommend giving Player's a try!

input: terrible food and the manager was shockingly rude when I tried to return my food. I had the frogs legs and they were rubbery and tasted awful. I was disgusted by her behavior and she should be ashamed of herself. I have never been treated more horribly by someone.
Help me polish this: I had an unpleasant dining experience at this restaurant, as the food was subpar and the manager's behavior towards me was shockingly rude. Specifically, I ordered the frogs legs, but they were disappointingly rubbery and had a terrible taste. I was left feeling disgusted by the manager's conduct, and frankly, she should be ashamed of herself. This encounter has undoubtedly been one of the worst treatments I have ever received from someone.

input:
The location is pretty random (at the end of a long winding road with a bunch of other hotel off of the highway with no food nearby) and the building has seen better days.  

My room featured an unclean floor, torn wallpaper, dusty bathroom vents, and water spots in the bathroom.  The hallways might remind one of "red rum" and the building itself is ugly showing it's age as a product of the 70s (as am I so I can judge).

The bed was comfortable and the room serviceable but it was disappointing as I have grown accustomed to a higher level of quality in my Doubletree experience throughout the country.
Help me polish this:
The location appears to be quite isolated, situated at the end of a long and meandering road alongside a cluster of other hotels adjacent to the highway, with no dining options in close proximity. Additionally, the building itself, while possessing a distinct charm from its heyday, now exhibits signs of wear and tear.

Inside my room, I couldn't help but notice a rather lackluster state of affairs. The floor seemed to have been neglected in terms of cleanliness, the wallpaper bore noticeable tears, the bathroom vents were covered in a layer of dust, and there were unsightly water spots in the bathroom. Venturing through the hallways, one couldn't help but draw eerie parallels to the infamous "red rum" imagery. Moreover, the building, a testament to its 70s origin, unabashedly displayed its age, though, as an individual who shares the same era, I can perhaps be a little more discerning.

On a somewhat brighter note, the bed itself provided a level of comfort, and the room, while lacking in its overall appeal, still offered a serviceable experience. Nevertheless, I must admit that as someone who has come to expect a higher standard of quality in my Doubletree encounters across the country, this particular stay proved to be somewhat disappointing.

input:
The hotel is beautifully done. It has a boutique feel and not like just a normal hotel like the Hilton. I had my birthday party there at the restaurant and it was so very nice. The service was wonderful and the rooms are beautiful. The air conditioner was pretty loud in our room but that is my only complaint. It's very close to Printers Alley which is so cool! 
I would definitely stay in this hotel again!
Help me polish this: The hotel is exquisitely designed, exuding a boutique atmosphere that sets it apart from conventional hotels like the Hilton. I had the pleasure of celebrating my birthday at the hotel's restaurant, and the experience was truly memorable. The service was exceptional, and the rooms were adorned with captivating elegance. The only downside was that the air conditioner in our room emitted a rather noticeable noise, but aside from that, everything was perfect. Additionally, its proximity to Printers Alley, an incredibly trendy and vibrant area, only added to the hotel's appeal. Without a doubt, I would eagerly choose to stay at this remarkable establishment again.

input:
Cool spot in a great location.
We got there early, so didn't have the same crushing crowds others have talked about.
The bartenders are awesome.
Made me a Perfect Rye Manhattan on the rocks, never had one before...I'm hooked.
Easily the best burger I've ever had!
Will absolutely be back
Help me polish this:
Polished version: 
This spot is undeniably cool and conveniently located. Arriving early helped us avoid the expected overwhelming crowds others have mentioned. The bartenders deserve a special mention for their exceptional skills. I had the pleasure of trying a Perfect Rye Manhattan on the rocks, which I had never tasted before, and it instantly became my new favorite drink. Furthermore, I can confidently say that the burger I had here was the finest I have ever experienced. Without hesitation, I will be returning in the future.

input: Excellent food and excellent service!  My new favorite breakfast place. I loved the biscuits and gravy, extra crispy bacon, sausage links and challah French toast!
Help me polish this: I highly recommend this place for its exceptional food and top-notch service! It has quickly become my go-to breakfast spot. The biscuits and gravy were absolutely fantastic, complemented perfectly by the extra crispy bacon, flavorful sausage links, and delightful challah French toast.

input: We hired Terra as the florist for our wedding and were very pleased with her work. We liked that she took the time to run through the venue with my husband and really tried to understand our needs and accommodate our budget. The florals for the wedding came out beautiful and we loved the draping for the ceremony and the reception. The only concern we had was that some of flowers in the bride's and the bridesmaids' bouquets started wilting during the day, but we understand that it is because the flowers were in full bloom and it could also have been due to the heat. Overall, we were happy we found Terra for our wedding!
Help me polish this: We were extremely satisfied with Terra, our hired florist for our wedding. Her attention to detail and willingness to familiarize herself with the venue and our preferences in order to work within our budget was commendable. The floral arrangements she created were absolutely stunning, and we were particularly pleased with the elegant draping she implemented for both the ceremony and the reception. The only minor concern we had was that a few flowers in both the bride's and bridesmaids' bouquets began wilting throughout the day. However, we understand that this could be attributed to the flowers being in full bloom and possibly affected by the heat. Despite this, finding Terra for our wedding was truly a delightful discovery!

input: Excellent healthy options for NOLA dining with lots of to go choices. I had turkey meatballs and spaghetti. It is a wonderful lunch place.
Help me polish this: Looking for some fantastic healthy dining options in New Orleans? Look no further! Whether you're dining in or prefer to enjoy your meal to-go, this place has got you covered. I recently tried their turkey meatballs with spaghetti, and it was absolutely delicious. With a variety of nutritious choices on their menu, this eatery is the perfect spot for a wonderful lunch experience.

input: This is everything I want in take out food - fresh, yummy, and relatively healthy. I also love that there is a good to go place in Northern Liberties that is convenient - there is not enough of that!
Help me polish this: I absolutely love everything about this takeout food! It's fresh, delicious, and remarkably healthy. Additionally, what I truly appreciate is the presence of a convenient "good to go" spot in Northern Liberties. It's a rarity to find such a place, and it adds to the overall appeal.

input:
We had an alumni event here and I really enjoyed it. It's dimly lit, very cozy inside - it's decorated kind of like an old library. It was a great quiet,casual spot if you're looking for a low key place to have good drinks. 

They have a few beers and wines, but we focused mostly on the happy hour cocktails - moscow mules, old fashioneds, etc. Everyone loved theirs, no complaints!
Help me polish this:
We recently hosted an alumni event at this charming venue, and I must say, I thoroughly enjoyed every moment. The ambiance is delightful with dim lighting and a cozy interior, reminiscent of a vintage library. If you're seeking a relaxed and intimate setting to enjoy some quality beverages, this place would be your go-to.

While they do offer a selection of beers and wines, our attention was primarily drawn to their impressive array of happy hour cocktails. From refreshing Moscow Mules to classic Old Fashioneds, we indulged in a variety of expertly crafted concoctions. Not a single complaint was heard as everyone was thoroughly pleased with their drink choices.

input: The burgers are amazing! French fries are decent (so get the onion rings).
Help me polish this: The burgers offered here are absolutely amazing! The combination of flavors and quality of the meat makes them a standout choice. While the french fries are decent, I would highly recommend opting for the onion rings instead. Their crispy and flavorful nature will elevate your dining experience even further.

input: Ive eaten there twice and both times it was terrible. Steak was salty, fish dry, my salad was frozen , service awful. . Im really not sure how this place gets any good reviews.
Help me polish this: I've dined there twice and unfortunately, both experiences were incredibly disappointing. On both occasions, the steak I ordered was extremely salty and the fish was undeniably dry. To make matters worse, my salad was shockingly frozen, and the service was simply appalling. I truly cannot comprehend how this establishment manages to receive any positive reviews.

input: Even after finding many great Spanish restaurants in the country (mostly NYC), Modesto is still one of my favorite Spanish place to eat.  This place is really good!  Too bad I don't live near St. Louis anymore since this is one of the places that I miss.
Help me polish this: Even after exploring various Spanish restaurants across the country, particularly in NYC, Modesto remains one of my top choices for a delightful Spanish dining experience. This place truly excels in all aspects! Unfortunately, as I no longer reside near St. Louis, it saddens me to realize that Modesto is one of those nostalgic places I dearly miss.

input:
Wow what a terrible spa. I can only speak for the manicure/pedicure aspect because I did not get a massage. Typically, you go to a spa to escape and relax - you can not do that here. It is small, dirty, and the staff is terrible. 

I walked in and the receptionist was on the phone - he did acknowledge that I was standing there, but several staff walked by and did not offer to assist. Finally, after two other guests came in behind me, someone came up and took me back - just to get me out of the way. Asked what my name was and left. Did not offer me water/refreshments of any kind. I've had better reception at the local nail salon. Then I had to wait for 10-15 minutes for my technician to finish up her current client, which I didn't mind because I leisurely picked out my color. When it was my turn, the nail technician was shaky and rushed. She cut my cuticle and I bled. She was sick and kept blowing her nose into her shirt (gross!!) and took time outs to really blow/dig in her nose with a tissue right in front of me! Lady, you are touching my hands with yours, you are blowing bacteria into the air, if you are that sick don't come to work - *Management, if your employee is that sick do not make them come in! You will lose clients. 

She gave me the worst hand/arm massage I have ever had (that is usually everyone's favorite part, and the technician's opportunity to shine!). No pressure was applied, and she just basically rubbed lotion into my skin and made a snarky comment about how my skin was so dry is was just "drinking up all the lotion." Yes, I realize it's dry, probably due to the 20 degree weather and wind outside, but thank you for making me feel self-conscious. 

When I went to leave the receptionist was on the phone again, but did actually put them on hold to get me out of there. I opted to put everything on my room charge, which resulted in extra fees but I didn't care. There was a blaring sign saying how they preferred cash gratuity and that there would be extra fees associated with putting services on your room. Yes, everyone prefers cash gratuity - but how tacky can you be?!! 

Overall, it was an extremely disappointing experience. I have been wanting to stay at the Monteleone for years and made it a priority to experience their salon. My gel nail polish is already chipping and it hasn't even been a week. Spa Aria definitely needs a overhaul and I would recommend you go anywhere else but here.
Help me polish this:

input: I got the hot shave and it did not disappoint. They do 6 towels and a facial massage with oils in between. Great shave, great environment.
Help me polish this: I recently had the pleasure of experiencing their hot shave, and I must say, it absolutely exceeded my expectations. Not only did they provide me with a fantastic shave, but they also went the extra mile by offering six towels and an indulgent facial massage using oils. The entire experience was top-notch, with a fantastic atmosphere that further enhanced my overall satisfaction.

input: We've been going to this place since it opened and it's always decent, not to mention super fast! TdM is owned by Subway and has a similar feel to it, but I think the quality is much better than Subway. It's a build-your-own burrito and taco place and the ingredients are always fresh and well-stocked. I usually eat vegetarian, so there are plenty of options for me to eat. I always get a veggie burrito and load it up with lots of veggies! I also like their chips and "medium" salsa. If ever around Delgado, check out Taco del Mar!
Help me polish this: We've been loyal customers of Taco del Mar ever since it first opened, and we've always had a consistently positive experience there. Not only is the service lightning-fast, but the quality of their food surpasses that of Subway, which shares a similar concept. Taco del Mar offers a build-your-own burrito and taco experience, using consistently fresh and well-stocked ingredients. As a vegetarian, I appreciate the plethora of options available to me, ensuring a satisfying meal every time. My go-to order is their veggie burrito, generously packed with an abundance of fresh vegetables. Additionally, their chips and "medium" salsa are simply delightful, complementing the meal perfectly. If you happen to find yourself in the Delgado area, don't miss out on the opportunity to try Taco del Mar!

input: I only go here when I need something that Trader Joes doesn't carry. They are overpriced, and understaffed. Not a fan.
Help me polish this: I only visit this store when I cannot find specific items at Trader Joe's. Unfortunately, I find this store to be overpriced and consistently lacking sufficient staff. Consequently, I am not particularly fond of it.

input: Listen up, people!  Fall off the bone mushy ribs are not what you get at a proper barbeque joint!  If you want that stuff, then go elsewhere.  Smoked ribs are meant to be a little tough.
Help me polish this: Attention, everyone! I'd like to clarify something important. Tender, fall-off-the-bone ribs are not what you'll find at an authentic barbecue establishment! If you're searching for that kind of texture, I'd suggest looking elsewhere. Truly smoked ribs are intended to have a slight toughness to them.

input: Amazing place for lassi and chaat. The chaat is elegantly presented and tastes like traditional Karachi chaat. However, the chaat isn't as nearly as good as the lassi. It is soft and creamy and sweetened beautifully. Will be coming back for sure next time I'm in the area.
Help me polish this: An incredible spot for lassi and chaat! The chaat is delightfully presented with an elegant touch that truly captures the essence of traditional Karachi flavors. Although the chaat falls slightly short of the exceptional lassi, it still manages to hold its own. On the other hand, the lassi is irresistible, boasting a divine combination of velvety smoothness, rich creaminess, and perfectly balanced sweetness. Without a doubt, I will make a definite return to this place whenever I find myself in the area again.

input: My husband and I held our wedding reception at Hendel's Cafe and it was gorgeous, just a beautiful night and a perfect place in which to spend with our closest friends and family!
Help me polish this: My husband and I recently hosted our wedding reception at Hendel's Cafe, and I must say, it was truly a spectacular event. The evening was simply filled with beauty and joy, providing us with the perfect setting to celebrate alongside our dearest friends and cherished family members.

input: Cockroach in my room, wifi is slower than aol in 1996, private beach costs $10 a chair. I'll never come here again.
Help me polish this: I had an unfortunate encounter with a cockroach in my room. On top of that, the wifi here feels slower than the dial-up connections from 1996. To add insult to injury, they charge a whopping $10 for every beach chair at their private beach. This whole experience has left me extremely disappointed, and I can confidently say that I'll never choose to come back here in the future.

input:
Our first visit to El Sol was to celebrate my daughter's birthday.  Needless to say, we were all BLOWN AWAY!   Our waiter was so attentive and polite, the pina colodas, margaritas and food was to die for, and at the end of the meal the whole staff came out with a very large cake, a desert for my daughter, sombreros and FIREWORKS!!  Birthday songs were played on the televisions and it was very festive.  
I'm so happy this gem is close enough to make regular dinner visits.  I'm also happy that an order of fajitas will feed me for dinner an lunch the next day. 
Good job, guys!
Help me polish this:
Our first visit to El Sol was truly an unforgettable experience as we gathered to celebrate my daughter's birthday. From the moment we walked in, we were captivated by the extraordinary level of service provided by our waiter, who was not only attentive but also exceptionally polite. The pina colodas, margaritas, and food selection left us absolutely speechless - each bite was simply heavenly. To our surprise, at the end of our meal, the entire staff emerged with a massive birthday cake, a special dessert exclusively for my daughter, sombreros, and even fireworks! The atmosphere was electric as birthday songs echoed through the televisions, creating a truly festive vibe. 

We are thrilled to have discovered this hidden gem, conveniently located nearby, and we have already made plans for regular dinner visits. Additionally, it's worth mentioning that the portion sizes are incredibly generous - one order of fajitas was enough to satisfy me for both dinner and lunch the following day. Bravo to the entire team at El Sol for a job well done!

input: What a hidden gem of a restaurant.  While everyone else go to Taco Bus and stands in long lines I'll come here to Taco Son and get just as good of food without the lines. Everything here is made from scratch and you can taste the freshness of the ingredients.  The portions are big so you get your monies worth. Oh and their breakfast burritos are killer grab you one after a long night.
Help me polish this: What a hidden gem of a restaurant! While everyone else lines up at Taco Bus, I prefer to come here to Taco Son for equally delicious food without the long wait. Every dish is made from scratch, giving you a delightful taste of freshness in every bite. The portion sizes are generous, ensuring you get great value for your money. And don't even get me started on their breakfast burritos - they are absolutely incredible. Trust me, after a long night, grabbing one of their breakfast burritos is a killer way to start the day.

input: We recently purchased a used car for my son, it was a 2006 and of course comes with no warranty because of the age, but I expected them to send it home with us in a safe condition. It was supposedly just inspected and had a brand new PA state inspection and oil change sticker from Conicelli. Needless to say we got it home and the next day the front left tire blew . It was completely dry rotted on the backside and the tire shop ended up replacing both front tires for $450. Money is one thing but after seeing how the tire just shredded we could have been killed on I95 on the way home. The tire just entirely fell apart. Never would recommend them now.
Help me polish this: We recently purchased a used car for my son - a 2006 model - without a warranty due to its age. However, we did expect the car to be in a safe condition when we brought it home. The dealer claimed that the car had undergone an inspection and had a new PA state inspection and oil change sticker from Conicelli. Unfortunately, the very next day, the front left tire blew out unexpectedly. Upon closer examination, we discovered that the tire was completely dry rotted on the backside. As a result, we had to replace both front tires at the cost of $450. While the financial burden is significant, it is the potential danger that truly alarms us. The tire fell apart entirely, and had this happened on our way home on I95, it could have put our lives at risk. Given this experience, I cannot recommend them to others.

input: Food is on point.  I am deducting 1 star for the condition of the bathrooms on the Friday night I went.. Toilet didn't flush, no toilet paper or paper towels and overall gross.
Help me polish this: The food was excellent, without a doubt. However, I regretfully have to deduct one star from my overall experience due to the appalling condition of the bathrooms during my visit on a Friday night. The toilet was not functioning properly, and there was a severe lack of essential supplies such as toilet paper and paper towels. The overall cleanliness was also quite disappointing.

input: Great food, awful service. I ordered online at 6:20, site said it would be ready at 6:40. I get there at 6:37 and i expected to wait a couple minutes but not the entire 20 minutes it takes to cook my food. They didn't even start cooking it till i got there. I leave at 7. They did nothing for the inconvenience and still made me pay full. Honestly, I'm so upset with how the whole situation was handled. Where is the customer service??
Help me polish this:
I had a very disappointing experience with this restaurant. While the food was great, the service was absolutely awful. I placed my order online at 6:20, and the website informed me that it would be ready by 6:40. Arriving at 6:37, I expected to wait just a few moments, but to my dismay, my food hadn't even been started cooking. It took them a full 20 minutes to begin cooking my order, leaving me waiting until 7. 

To make matters worse, despite the inconvenience caused, they showed no concern or effort to make it right. My wife and I had been wanting to go here but just hadn't made it a priority.  

I had the fish and chips.  The batter wasn't thick, and it has a crispiness to it that was a great contrast to the moistness and juiciness of the fish.  I have to admit, when I'm not sure what to get I think of getting a burger or fish & chips, and there weren't any burgers on the dinner menu.  The serving size was 3 cod pieces, approx 4-6 oz, along with a generous serving of fries. Additionally, the tartar sauce appeared to be made in house, had a great flavor.  So, if you're in the mood for fish and chips, I would highly recommend getting them here...because while the serving size isn't as big as Great Basin's, it tastes way better.

My wife had the salmon tacos, and for the side she had the chicken tortilla soup.  While the tacos had some great flavors the salmon was a bit overcooked, thus making the tacos a bit overshadowed by the soup.  Similar to the fish & chips above, the serving size wasn't large, only 2 tacos, but again, the flavors were very good.

If you're starving and want a large meal with leftovers I'd recommend other places, but if you want a satisfying meal that's an appropriate size this place is very good.

input:
Wildflower is a super scrum, cute little restaurant. I've been here twice now for lunch, unfortunately I am always too late for breakfast. Fortunately though, their lunch is delicious! I took my mum here for her birthday for lunch and we were both so pleased!! 

Sad to say, but due to some health issues, I've had to really change my diet around. This was my first time going out to eat since being on this new regimen. I'm definitely limited, which is too bad, and there was a lot I couldn't have. The menu has good selections, but there is a lot with meat, and I've been a vegetarian for years. Regardless, they serve great food, I just like big menus. Everything is made in house and they use fresh and local ingredients. My mum got the Vermonter salad, which she LOVED!!! It had mixed greens, Vermont cheddar, applewood smoked bacon, pecans, and dried cherries. The dressing was a home made honey vinaigrette I believe. It came with two delicious pieces of muesli bread with a home made honey butter. YUM!! I had the tuna plate, which was great too. It had a very good portion of tuna salad, mixed greens, mixed veggies, and came with a biscuit with that delicious honey butter. It also came with a fresh fruit bowl!!!! I couldn't have the biscuit so I traded for muesli and man that stuff was delicious. My mum loves the biscuit too. Everything is definitely made with love and happiness here!!!

The patio is so cute, 4 tables on a nice little deck with fans and hanging lights. Our server was wonderful, SO kind and adorable. She even brought my mum
a homemade red velvet cupcake with a candle, which LOOKED amazing, and she thought was delicious. Another win at Wildflower, would love to come back for breakfast sometime.

Nevertheless, this doesn't diminish the fact that the restaurant serves up exceptional dishes; I simply prefer restaurants with larger menus. All their food is prepared in-house using fresh, locally sourced ingredients.

My mum's choice, the Vermonter salad, was a resounding success. Its combination of mixed greens, Vermont cheddar, applewood smoked bacon, pecans, and dried cherries was a true delight. The ensemble was tastefully enhanced by a homemade honey vinaigrette. To accompany the salad, two delectable slices of muesli bread were served alongside a delightful homemade honey butter. My own selection, the tuna plate, was equally satisfying. It comprised a generous portion of tuna salad, accompanied by mixed greens, mixed veggies, and a biscuit smothered in tantalizing honey butter. As a delightful bonus, a fresh fruit bowl was also included. Unfortunately, I couldn't enjoy the biscuit due to my dietary restrictions, so I happily swapped it for the mouthwatering muesli bread. My mum also couldn't resist praising the quality of the biscuits. It's evident that everything at Wildflower is crafted with love and a genuine desire to please.

Another highlight of our visit was the delightful patio area. Four tables are nestled on a charming deck adorned with fans and twinkling hanging lights. We thoroughly enjoyed the cozy ambiance it provided. Additionally, our server was an absolute gem—kind, endearing, and attentive. Spasso is definitely recommended for a great dinner in Media!

Upon leaving, take advantage of the complimentary Dum Dum lollipops at the counter, a sweet treat that adds a nice touch to the overall experience. Additionally, newspapers are available for solo diners or those who wish to catch up on Philadelphia Phillies updates.

The food at West Ave. Grill never disappoints. Their pancakes are a standout, boasting a delightful combination of fluffy texture and crispy edges. The Kansas City breakfast is also highly recommended, with a variety of delectable dishes to choose from that will satisfy your morning cravings.

One minor critique would be that the salads could benefit from a more generous amount of toppings and ingredients, ensuring they match their description and provide a satisfying meal. However, the staff is always attentive and eager to address any concerns, going above and beyond to ensure a pleasant dining experience.

In summary, West Ave. Grill offers a pleasant and enjoyable dining experience in Jenkintown. From their delicious breakfast options to their accommodating service, this restaurant is worth a visit. Give it a try - you won't be disappointed.

input:
We found ourselves in South Tucson needing a good meal from somewhere other than the kitchens of the chain hotels surrounding the airport.  Thank you Yelpers for delivering another great place!

A reconverted 1960's era A & W chain fast food stand [I can detect those old bone shards still!], we enjoyed a wonderful meal at a reasonable price.

I had the catfish smothered in poblano sauce and melted cheese.  They told me it was farm catfish but it tasted like the catfish I used to catch out of a lake near my house as a little kid.  Farm fish never tastes this real.

My wife had chile relleno - fresh peppers, not surprising this time of year but definite kudos to the chef.

The late-stage adolescents with us enjoyed their enhiladas and chimichangas too.
Help me polish this:
We found ourselves in South Tucson, craving a delicious meal that wouldn't be served from the generic kitchens of the chain hotels surrounding the airport. Thanks to the recommendations of fellow Yelpers, we stumbled upon another hidden gem.

Housed in a reconverted 1960s A & W chain fast food stand, the nostalgia was palpable; I even detected remnants of old bone shards from its previous life. However, what impressed us the most was the delectable meal we enjoyed at an incredibly reasonable price.

Opting for the catfish smothered in poblano sauce and melted cheese, I was pleasantly surprised by the authentic flavors. They claimed it was farm catfish, but the taste transported me back to my childhood days of reeling in catfish from a nearby lake. It's remarkable how farm fish never quite captures that genuine essence.

My wife decided on the chile relleno, featuring fresh peppers that were no surprise given the time of year. The chef truly deserves commendation for this delightful choice.

Our accompanying late-stage adolescents also found joy in their enchiladas and chimichangas. It was evident that the entire menu was crafted with care and expertise.

Once again, we are grateful to the Yelpers who led us to this fantastic dining experience.

input:
Have only been once a couple of months ago, so maybe this was a one-off experience...Ordered a piece of carrot cake, which tasted fine. Certainly not the best I've ever had but good enough. The to go packaging was a bit overkill just for that one slice of cake, as was the $10 price tag. That being said, I'm sure the "fanciness" of the place is what makes it so appealing to folks. It really is quite unique and cute for our area and would be a good place to go with the gals (rather than my husband who hates all things trendy, lol). 

My problem, though, was with the service. We placed our order for the carrot cake with a nice young teenager, and then waited. And waited. I could see the carrot cake just sitting in the pretty covered cake stand, and I felt really tempted to just slice it myself. After a bit (felt like 10 minutes, although I'm sure it was more like 5 or 6), another employee came and sliced the carrot cake, setting the slice on the back counter with the ticket. And then we waited. And waited some more. After about another 5 to 10 minutes, I flagged the teenager down and asked if he could box up the cake for us. He seemed confused, and it took an awkward minute-long exchange for him to understand we hadn't yet received our order. He did apologize for the wait, which I do appreciate, boxed up the cake, and then we were on our way.

I should clarify that we did not go into the shop at a busy time. It was a relatively cool day and not many people were out. While there were maybe 2 to 3 tables seated, we were the only ones at the counter ordering. And while I'm sure the wait staff who repeatedly walked by our lonely piece of carrot cake sitting on the back counter had many important tasks...I just wanted to eat my $10 cake.

Four stars for the cake. Two stars for the service.

input:
The gym part of City Fitness is better than most, good equipment, clean, variety, it's a nice gym. I find the rates reasonable and have been a member since they opened and will continue to be a member. So, for the rating I give the gym at CF a 3.5 star, I give MBSC a 1.5 star for an overall 2.5 star rating.

MBSC review: I thought I would kick it up a notch so joined the MBSC thrive program at CF on South Street and tried it for three months. Trainers really aren't "personal" trainers. They have a set program that they put people through and you have very little to say about what you like/don't like. The trainers work with several people in a session so depending on how many people are in a session you could be waiting for the trainer to get back to you or waiting for the person in front of you to finish. One of the things that frustrated me is they want you to push through the routine they have come up for you in the hour's time. The sessions are hard with ropes, sleds, balls, bands, cables, weights and the most uncomfortable stationary bike I've ever had to sit on (and they make you end every session on the thing). No two sessions are alike - so if you like variety then great, if you like consistency or at least enough repetition to get the moves and form down then not so great. I seldom found a session to be fun or enjoyable, rather I often felt like I was a contestant on the Biggest Loser. They also play hip-hop all day long and you either like it or you don't. The environment and training is designed (in my opinion) to appeal to 20-30yo demographic.

If you really want to push yourself beyond your limits and don't care how you get there then you might really enjoy the MBSC program. If you want a professional personal trainer to spend quality time with you in achieving your goals and if you want a training program that you actually learn what muscle groups you are working and not just to be pushed through a routine then you probably won't like MBSC. Definitely do a introductory program because the usual 30 day notice from the contract date applies if you cancel and it's $200+/mo program.
Help me polish this:
City Fitness's gym is superior to most others, boasting high-quality equipment, cleanliness, and a wide variety of options. It is truly a pleasant gym to be a part of, and I find their rates to be reasonable, which is why I have been a member since they first opened and plan to continue my membership. Given these factors, I would rate City Fitness's gym at 3.5 stars.

In contrast, my experience with the MBSC thrive program at City Fitness on South Street left much to be desired. The trainers were not truly "personal" trainers, as they followed a set program and allowed little input from the participants. Furthermore, the trainers worked with multiple people per session, causing delays and potential inefficient use of time. I was often frustrated by the insistence on pushing through a pre-determined routine within the hour-long sessions. These sessions were physically demanding, incorporating various equipment such as ropes, sleds, balls, bands, cables, weights, and an uncomfortable stationary bike that was always the final activity. While the sessions offered variety, lacking consistency made it difficult to master proper form and movements. I rarely found these sessions enjoyable, often feeling like I was on a reality TV show like the Biggest Loser. Additionally, hip-hop music played throughout the gym, catering primarily to a younger demographic aged 20-30.

If you are looking to surpass your limits regardless of the method, the MBSC program may be enjoyable for you. However, if you desire a professional personal trainer who dedicates quality time to your goals and an educational training program that helps you understand the specific muscle groups being targeted, MBSC may not be suitable. It is advisable to start with an introductory program, as cancellations require a 30-day notice from the contract date, and the program itself costs over $200 per month.

input:
Four stars for price. 
I drive truck, so I've eaten bbq all over America. This place is better than most, but it's certainly not 4 star worthy. I'd say the food is more like 2.5 star. 
The cheeseburger was quite large and the meat was tasty. (Be advised: if you don't stop them they'll automatically put that disgusting invention called mayonnaise on it.) I got it plain so I can't comment on their lettuce/tomato game. 
The pork bbq sammich was soggy on the bottom. Moist is good, but this was just plain wet. The meat itself was bland but not bad. 
The bbq sauce is pretty good but not great. 
The Mac & Cheese tasted ok but the noodles were way overcooked. It'd be much better if it were baked and had a little crustiness to it. 

If I lived local I'm sure I'd come here occasionally.
Help me polish this:
Four stars for the price! As a truck driver who has tried BBQ all across America, I must say that this place surpasses many others. However, I believe it falls short of deserving a four-star rating. Personally, I would rate the food at about 2.5 stars.

The cheeseburger was impressively large and the meat was delicious. Just a heads up, they tend to automatically add mayonnaise, so be sure to specify if you don't want it. I opted for a plain burger, so I can't speak for the quality of their lettuce and tomato toppings.

On the other hand, the pork BBQ sandwich left something to be desired. It was quite soggy on the bottom, which is a turn-off for me. While the meat itself was lacking a bit in flavor, it wasn't terrible.

As for the BBQ sauce, it was decent but not outstanding.

The Mac & Cheese had an okay taste, but the noodles were severely overcooked. I think it would greatly benefit from being baked and having a slightly crispy texture.

If I were a local resident, I can definitely see myself stopping by occasionally to grab a meal here.

input:
So we've been wanting to try the sushiritos since they opened up a location closer to us and we finally tried it last Friday. 

I got the slammin' salmon and my wife got the crunch. I'd say they both definitely had fresh ingredients, and definitely tasted fresh, but I think the balance of flavors wasn't quite right for the slammin' salmon. Way too heavy on the sauce, completely overpowering the crisp fresh veggies and salmon. 

We tried the Japanese fried chicken. Sauce is a little sweet and sour. And the chicken was a little dry. 

We also tried their green tea and lemonade, which were pretty good, but you don't come to a place like this because their green tea and lemonade are their best things on the menu. 

Overall, you pay a high premium for a gimmicky meal. With this location being essentially at a revolving door of new customers on the corner of Penn's campus, I think they have the potential to do well. But I don't think I'll be coming back. We'll take our $34 elsewhere.
Help me polish this:

The ingredients were undeniably fresh, and the taste reflected that as well. However, I felt that the slammin' salmon had an imbalance of flavors. The heavy sauce overpowered the crisp freshness of the veggies and salmon.

We also decided to try the Japanese fried chicken, which had a slightly sweet and sour sauce. Unfortunately, the chicken itself was a little dry.

On a more positive note, we quite enjoyed their green tea and lemonade. That said, we didn't come to this place solely for their beverages; there were higher expectations for the main dishes.

Overall, it seems like you pay a premium for a somewhat gimmicky meal. Given that this location is constantly bustling with new customers near Penn's campus, it has the potential to thrive. However, personally, I don't think we'll be returning. We would rather spend our $34 elsewhere.

Although I wish Enzo's still offered the pizzas they had during their time as Nabruzzi, I will still continue to order food from them.

input:

However, I stayed in room 263 and thought it was perfect because it was not a room that faced Conti.  I was wrong because it was closer to the vending and ice machines.  The door/wall was thin enough that I heard conversations in the hall next to the vending machines.

I would have rated the hotel with 4 stars if it wasn't for the thin walls.
Help me polish this:
This is a fantastic place to stay if you want to be right on Bourbon street. The staff here are incredibly welcoming and their recommendations for food were spot on. The room itself is spacious and well-maintained. However, I stayed in room 263, thinking it would be ideal as it didn't face Conti street. Unfortunately, it was closer to the vending and ice machines, and I realized that the walls were thin enough to hear conversations in the hallway near the machines.

Overall, I had a great experience here and would have given it a 4-star rating if it weren't for the issue with the thin walls.

input: Went to ocharleys on a Sunday afternoon, it wasn't too busy but I guess our server was overwhelmed. He forgot our bread and butter. Forgot my fries multiple times, I was halfway done with my sandwich when my fries finally arrived. We got my son Sprite refilled at the bar after waiting so long for our waiter. We had a coupon that we told the server to add to our bill. Well he forgot to ring it up correctly, he got the manager to fix it. I might give ocharleys another try for lunch instead of dinner.
Help me polish this: I visited O'Charley's on a Sunday afternoon and found that despite the relatively light crowd, our server seemed overwhelmed. Unfortunately, he forgot to bring us our bread and butter, and even overlooked bringing my fries on multiple occasions. I was already halfway through my sandwich by the time the fries finally made an appearance. To make matters worse, we had to wait a considerable amount of time for our waiter to refill my son's Sprite and ended up having to go to the bar for the service. Additionally, we had a coupon that we specifically mentioned to the server, yet he failed to ring it up correctly. Thankfully, the manager intervened and resolved the issue. Considering the overall experience, I might consider giving O'Charley's another chance for lunch as opposed to dinner.

input: this place SUCKS. Terrible service and overpriced mediocre food. This is my second time with the same results. input:
They just opened today and WOW! Aren't we lucky to now have 2 meaderies within a mile or two of each other. 
Mead is a type of fermented honey beverage. The ABV (alcohol percent) is generally 10-14% so more along the lines of wine than beer there. 

We tried Goober Vitis (peanut butter and jelly), Suzy's Cherry Pie, and the coffee one. All were PERFECT. Flavors are pure, beautiful nose, all around great. 

The space is very nice, nice big tables that seat 6-8 easily, an L-shaped bar, a stand-up bar around the tanks, then there are picnic tables outside.
Help me polish this:
They just opened today, and I must say, WOW! We are truly fortunate to now have not one, but two meaderies located within a mile or two of each other. Mead, a type of fermented honey beverage, boasts an ABV (alcohol percent) of generally 10-14%, making it more closely aligned with wine rather than beer.

We had the pleasure of trying their Goober Vitis (peanut butter and jelly), Suzy's Cherry Pie, and the coffee-flavored meads. And let me tell you, they were flawless. The flavors were pure, accompanied by a delightful aroma, and overall, they were simply outstanding.

The space itself is quite impressive, with spacious tables that easily accommodate 6-8 people. In addition, there is an inviting L-shaped bar, a stand-up bar surrounding the tanks, and even picnic tables outside for those who prefer to enjoy their mead in the fresh air.

input: I eat at Pina's or take-out about once a month. My favorites includes their dinner specials, cheesesteaks, calzones, and seafood dishes. The shrimp scampi appetizer (sans linguini) and steamed clams are excellent  inexpensive. Service is always flawless. For casual dining this place is very good.
Help me polish this: I enjoy dining at Pina's or getting take-out from there about once a month. They have a great variety of menu options, including their delightful dinner specials, mouth-watering cheesesteaks, flavorful calzones, and delectable seafood dishes. I highly recommend trying their shrimp scampi appetizer without the linguini, as well as their steamed clams - both are reasonably priced and absolutely delicious. Furthermore, the service at Pina's is consistently flawless. Overall, if you're looking for a casual dining experience, this place is definitely worth a visit.

input: Great place to watch footy.  I was visiting town for work and needed a place to watch my blues take on barfalona and came across Chatham.  It was a Tuesday so they had $4 Guiness and Black and Tans. Had their fish and chips which was new experience for me. Never had fish that was so soft after being fried, but I really enjoyed it, almost the texture of a donut. Saw my team win and had a great time at this pub.
Help me polish this:
Chatham is an excellent spot to catch a football match. I was in town for business and wanted to find the perfect place to watch my team, the blues, go head to head against barfalona. Luckily, I stumbled upon Chatham, a fantastic pub that exceeded my expectations.

Visiting on a Tuesday, I was pleased to discover their irresistible offer of $4 Guinness and Black and Tans. To complete my experience, I decided to try their fish and chips, which turned out to be a delightful novelty for me. I have never encountered fish that remained so tender and delicate even after being fried. The texture was almost reminiscent of a donut, adding to the unique experience. 

The highlight of my evening was undoubtedly witnessing my team's triumph while embracing the lively atmosphere with fellow football enthusiasts at this pub. I had an absolutely wonderful time at Chatham and highly recommend it as a must-visit spot for any football fan.

input: This is the place we have been searching for! input: This is our go-to takeout place. It has great food and exceptionally fast service. I live at 2601 Parkway and they deliver right to the door of my condo which many delivery places don't do. Their staff is friendly, make great pizza, and generally run such a business as best you can.

input: Top notch street tacos, great service and hand made horchata made this a top notch stop

input:
I went in for a mani and pedi. My student was a nice person and we chatted. However it took 3 hours and my hands just look terrible. The feet are fine and feel great. Hands, just terrible. No one came and checked in if the work was done properly. I'm fine that it takes longer, they are there to learn. However, I shouldn't have been charged for the manicure (pedicure yes) or at least have someone else redo my nails. See the pictures for yourselves, this is 15 minutes out!

Edit: just wanted to add that when I removed my shoes, my pedi was ruined. I asked if it was ready to put shoes on and I was told yes. 2 stars only because at least my student was nice but 0 for the service (34$!)
Help me polish this:
I went in to get a manicure and pedicure, hoping for a relaxing experience. My assigned student, who was pleasant to chat with, performed the services. However, the entire process ended up taking three hours, and I must admit, the results on my hands were disappointing. While my feet felt great and looked fine, my hands were in a terrible state. What bothered me even more was that no one checked in on the quality of the work or offered to fix the issues.

I understand that the students are there to learn, and I am patient when it comes to the extra time it may take them. However, I strongly believe that I should not have been charged for the manicure, or at the very least, someone else should have been called upon to redo my nails. I have attached pictures for your reference, which were taken just 15 minutes after leaving the salon.

Additionally, I want to mention that when I removed my shoes, my pedicure was already ruined. I had specifically asked if it was safe to put my shoes back on and was assured that it was. Overall, I would rate the experience with two stars, solely due to the friendly nature of the student, but unfortunately, zero stars for the service itself, especially considering the hefty $34 price tag.

input: Very nice, quiet and dark restaurant. Chinese and sushi offered. Had szechuan chicken, hot and sour soup, and steamed rice. Hubbie had the prime rib and shrimp hot pot. Just the right amount of food. Didn't have to take any home. Service was excellent.
Help me polish this: We thoroughly enjoyed our dining experience at this lovely, tranquil restaurant, which had a charming ambiance with its dim lighting. The menu boasted a delightful fusion of Chinese and sushi options, leaving us spoiled for choice. I decided on the Szechuan chicken accompanied by a piping hot and flavorful hot and sour soup alongside a side of impeccably cooked steamed rice. My husband, on the other hand, opted for the tantalizing prime rib and shrimp hot pot, which proved to be a succulent and satisfying choice. The portion sizes were perfectly proportioned, allowing us to relish every bite without feeling overwhelmed, and we were pleased to leave the restaurant without any leftovers. Moreover, the service provided was truly exceptional, with the staff going above and beyond to ensure our dining experience was seamless and enjoyable.

input: Frank is a great dentist and a very nice guy. He has a gentle manner, takes a sincere interest in his patients and in general is a top quality dentist and person. input: This was a nice spot with sidewalk lounge seating. Even had a DJ outside Friday night. There was a walk up bar outside too. The decor inside was pretty sweet. We tried a few appetizers and they were both good! It is located in a trendy waterfront area.

input: Stopped in tonight for a light bite to eat. I was so impressed! Great service, great fresh, fresh food and beautiful atmosphere- we sat outside in the warm October evening air. input: I've been to Lush in Arizona, S.F., San Jose and Maui. The one in New Orleans is My favorite one. I love how you can smell a Lush store from a block away. :) I've been to this one a few times, Always on Halloween. Always a fun time :)
Help me polish this: I've had the pleasure of visiting Lush stores in various locations, including Arizona, San Francisco, San Jose, and Maui. However, out of all the stores I've been to, the one in New Orleans remains my absolute favorite. One of the reasons I adore this store is because you can catch its incredible fragrance from a block away. It's truly a unique experience. I've been fortunate to have visited this particular store a few times, and I must say, going on Halloween adds an extra level of excitement and enjoyment to the experience. It always turns into a truly fun and memorable time.

input: Love love love this place for HH n dinner is good too! Its ok for brunch, not as great as what people praise it to be. The Asian Nachos are the dish to get for HH. Its an entree itself! The other HH dishes are great too. The creme brulee is amazing as with their other desserts. The blueberry mojito is awesome along with the mango sling. Great place to celebrate birthdays and such.  Nice feel to it. Bar area gets crowded as it gets later for HH. As usual around the mall, finding parking sux!
Help me polish this: I absolutely love this place for happy hour and dinner is also pretty good! It's decent for brunch, but not as amazing as people make it out to be. The Asian Nachos are an absolute must-try for happy hour, they could easily be a meal on their own! The other happy hour dishes are also fantastic. Trust me when I say that their creme brulee is out of this world, along with their other desserts. The blueberry mojito and mango sling are both awesome cocktails. It's a great spot to celebrate birthdays and other special occasions. The atmosphere is really nice, although the bar area tends to get crowded as the happy hour goes on. Just like any other place around the mall, finding parking can be a hassle.

input: Delicious top shelf pastries. I am outraged at the poor ratings. If you're looking for cheapness over flavor then go to Panera. Service has always been exceedingly pleasent when I go, and I am an obnoxious needy customer. We are so excited to have them make macaroons for our wedding.
Help me polish this: Indulge in exquisite, premium pastries. I am incredibly disappointed by the mediocre ratings they have received. If you prioritize affordability over exceptional taste, you might as well visit Panera. input: I could be craving pizza and be walking by and STILL not go in again. I will say the ingredients are definitely fresh and service was great however the pizza is just plain not good. The crust is so thin that the pizza is cold within a few minutes and it was just a little floppy and bland. I wanted to love this place but with so many other pizzerias in the area I won't be going back.
Help me polish this: No matter how strong my craving for pizza might be, I'm still unable to bring myself to step inside this place again. While I must acknowledge the freshness of the ingredients and the fantastic service, the pizza itself is simply subpar. Its thin crust is disappointingly inadequate, leading to a cold pizza in mere minutes, and the overall taste is lackluster and unremarkable. One would hope to develop an affinity for this establishment, but with an abundance of other pizzerias in the vicinity, I see no reason to return.

input: Love the tap room, but I can't seem to get the hours of business right.  My first visit was a kinda a let down.  I had heard that bier was the place to go for great beers in Indianapolis, but I only found 2 that I liked and only 1 was memorable.  However, bier rotates their taps weekly and does not seem to have any regular taps, I like this because it means that they are constantly challenging themselves to create a better beer.   The tap room is a lot of fun too with people constantly revolving around the taps to taste and find their favorite for the week and then relaxing and talking in the lounge area.  I only gave them 3stars this time but I look forward to improving their score after future visits.
Help me polish this:
I thoroughly enjoy the tap room, although I have been having trouble getting the correct hours of operation. My initial experience was somewhat disappointing. I had heard that bier was the ultimate destination for exceptional beers in Indianapolis, but I only discovered two that I genuinely enjoyed, and only one left a lasting impression. However, bier's unique approach of rotating their taps on a weekly basis, without any regular options, is quite intriguing. It clearly demonstrates their commitment to continuously push their boundaries and create even better brews.

The tap room itself is quite lively, with a constant stream of people hovering around the taps, eagerly sampling and searching for their favorite beer of the week. The lounge area provides a relaxed and enjoyable space to unwind and engage in conversations. Though I currently rate them at three stars, I am optimistic about enhancing this score through future visits.

input: Beautifully sweet ending to a sweet trip to NOLA with the girls. We stumbled upon this after a delicous savory lunch nearby at Cochon (review to follow). Sweet Confections is on Magazine St, around corner from the art gallery strip on Julia St.   We had a sampling of cupcake (chocolate with mocha filling) and truffles (raspberry, creme brulee, and orange).  Cupcake was good, mocha filling best part. Rasberry truffle was my fav, love the dark chocolate so it's not cloyingly sweet. The coffee was a wonderful chaser, not overly burnt, smoky, or acidic... I usually have coffee with milk n sugar, forgot this time, but I didn't even need it!  Seating was nice, with a few cafe tables inside. Enough for our 6-girl troop. And service was great, helpful with flavor suggestions and labelling.  Gave 4 of 5 stars because maybe they could benefit from one more equally gracious staff person.
Help me polish this:
We had a beautifully sweet ending to our trip to NOLA with the girls at Sweet Confections. We stumbled upon this charming bakery after enjoying a delicious savory lunch nearby at Cochon (review to follow). Located on Magazine St, just around the corner from the art gallery strip on Julia St, it was the perfect find.

At Sweet Confections, we indulged in a delightful sampling of their treats, including a delectable chocolate cupcake with mocha filling and a variety of truffles, such as raspberry, creme brulee, and orange. The cupcake was good, but the mocha filling was the standout for me. However, my favorite was definitely the raspberry truffle, as I loved the balance of dark chocolate without it being overly sweet. To accompany our treats, we enjoyed a wonderful cup of coffee. Surprisingly, even without adding milk and sugar like I usually do, the coffee was fantastic and didn't require any additional enhancements.

The seating at Sweet Confections was cozy and comfortable, with plenty of cafe tables inside that accommodated our group of six girls perfectly. The service was also exceptional, with the staff being helpful in providing flavor suggestions and labeling everything clearly.

Overall, I would give Sweet Confections a rating of 4 out of 5 stars. The only improvement I could suggest is perhaps having one more equally gracious staff member to enhance the overall customer experience.

input: Pulled pork sandwich was Delicious .. BUT! The lucky bun (Asian fusion style ) burger . Was a disappointment for the sole purpose of them using a frozen beef patty :/  the bread was good .. The toppings and sauces were great .. But just killed the flavors with a processed frozen beef patty .. If used a fresh ground meat .. It would have been a great gourmet burger ..
Help me polish this: The pulled pork sandwich was absolutely delicious, but unfortunately, I was slightly disappointed with the lucky bun (Asian fusion style) burger. The mere fact that they used a frozen beef patty was a bit of a letdown. Don't get me wrong, the bread was delightful and the toppings and sauces were fantastic. However, the overall flavor of the burger was greatly compromised due to the processed frozen beef patty. If only they had used fresh ground meat, it could have easily turned into a phenomenal gourmet burger.

input: This is a great place to bring the kids to. They can have juice, a slice of cake, and homemade popsicles. They think it is a tea party. input: Always awesome!  Best crust ever and super Fresh ingredients and nice staff.  Lots of yummy toppings that aren't offered at other pizza places.   Great salads too! Patio area is a cool place to kick back,have a beer or glass of wine and savor the best pizza in town.
